title: Sr. Full-Stack Engineer (AI & Automation)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.

﻿

Monthly salary: $5,000 - $5,500 USD


This role starts with the growth program buildout but is expected to expand into broader firm-wide technology initiatives over time. Along with our partner, we are seeking a versatile builder who can move fluidly between data engineering, automation, AI/ML, and full-stack development.


Core Responsibilities:

Growth Engine & Automation

  • Design and implement automated workflows that support all components of their growth strategy across channels with proper throttling, safety protocols, and compliance guardrails
  • Build internal dashboards and reporting to track pipeline KPIs, campaign performance, A/B test results, and ROI metrics


Data Architecture & Engineering

  • Design the data architecture that supports prospect enrichment, advisor matching, campaign analytics, and progressive profiling
  • Build and manage data pipelines that ingest, clean, and transform data from multiple sources (job change signals, financial triggers, intent data, CRM records)
  • Implement data models that enable segmentation, scoring, and intelligent routing of prospects to advisors
  • Ensure data integrity, privacy compliance, and proper governance across all systems


AI & Machine Learning

  • Develop and iterate on the advisor-prospect matching model using shared-affinity data, engagement signals, and personality indicators
  • Build progressive profiling logic that refines prospect profiles based on behavioral data collected throughout the outbound sequence
  • Identify and prototype additional AI/ML use cases as the program matures (predictive lead scoring, optimal send-time modeling, churn risk signals, etc.)
  • Evaluate and integrate third-party AI tools and APIs where they accelerate development


Full-Stack Development

  • Build interactive landing pages, lead magnets, and conversion-optimized web experiences tailored to specific prospect personas
  • Develop widgets, calculators, and interactive tools that serve as lead capture mechanisms (e.g., retirement readiness assessments, portfolio analysis tools)
  • Create advisor-facing internal tools as needed to support their growth program and broader firm operations
  • Contribute to additional technology projects as they emerge across the firm


Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience across backend, frontend, and data engineering
  • Strong proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and SQL
  • Experience building /cmanaging API integrations, data pipelines, MCPs and automation workflows
  • Working knowledge of CRM platforms (HubSpot/Salesforce Financial Services Cloud preferred), marketing automation tools and business intelligence systems
  • Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks and the ability to build, train, and deploy models in production
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment where priorities shift and scope expands
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with non-technical stakeholders
  • Familiarity with outbound sales infrastructure (email deliverability, LinkedIn automation safety, SMS/RCS protocols)
  • Experience with data enrichment platforms (Clay) and third-party data vendor integrations
  • Background in building lead scoring models, recommendation engines, or matching algorithms
  • Experience with front-end frameworks (React, Next.js) and modern web design


About the Engagement:

  • This engagement begins with their Organic Growth and Marketing team and is expected to expand firm-wide as the growth engine matures and additional technology needs emerge. The right partner will have the opportunity to shape the technical foundation of a program that is central to their long-term strategy. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role with direct influence on their growth trajectory.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to play a foundational role in building and scaling a data-driven growth engine at a forward-thinking, advisor-led wealth management firm.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Líder Técnico / PO Sênior
description:

title: Head of Digital Media
description:
About VEL


Civilization is shifting.

AI is no longer confined to the browser. Work is decentralizing. Cities are restructuring. Corporate real estate is contracting.

VEL is building Physical AI infrastructure — intelligent, distributed environments embedded into airports, commercial buildings, and urban nodes.

VEGA is what people experience. IRIS is the intelligence layer that governs it.

We are not building consumer apps.

We are building embodied AI systems operating in real-world environments.

Perception matters. Narrative matters. Authority matters.

This role exists to shape how the world understands what we are building.

The Role

The Head of Digital Media & Social Strategy owns VEL’s external narrative architecture across digital platforms — with primary emphasis on executive-level social presence.

This is not a community manager role.

This is not a paid ads role.

This is not influencer marketing.

This is strategic storytelling at infrastructure scale.

You will shape how investors, real estate partners, technologists, and operators perceive VEL.

Core Responsibilities

● Architect and manage CEO digital presence (LinkedIn, X primarily)

● Translate complex Physical AI concepts into compelling, high-authority content

● Build structured content cadence aligned with fundraise and deployment milestones

● Draft executive-level thought leadership

● Develop long-form and short-form narrative

● Oversee visual language consistency across platforms

● Coordinate announcements (product, partnerships, capital)

● Track audience quality, not vanity metrics

● Align digital positioning with capital strategy

This role requires editorial precision, strategic thinking, and executive-level maturity.

Mandatory Qualifications (Non-Negotiable)

You must have:

● 5+ years leading digital strategy or executive communications

● Direct experience managing a C-level executive’s social presence

● Demonstrated experience writing long-form thought leadership

● Experience in venture-backed, deep-tech, B2B, or infrastructure environments

● Strong understanding of LinkedIn-native growth mechanics

● Fluent professional English (written and spoken)

● Comfort working closely with a founder

You Are Likely Coming From

● A venture-backed startup

● A B2B technology company

● A deep-tech or AI company

● A founder-brand building role

● An executive communications leadership position


You understand that:

● Authority compounds over time

● Digital presence influences capital perception

● Language shapes market category

● Precision matters more than volume

● Infrastructure companies must sound different than consumer brands

You are strategic.

You are literate.

You think long-term.

Who Should Not Apply

● Influencer marketers

● Lifestyle brand managers

● Pure paid performance marketers

● Meme-driven content creators

● Candidates without executive-level writing experience


Travel Requirement

Up to 45-60 days per year may be required for:

● Deployment launches

● Investor events

● Manufacturing visits

● Strategic announcements

Candidates must be comfortable with periodic international travel.

Compensation

$40,000 – $60,000 USD + performance-based equity

Compensation reflects executive narrative responsibility and long-term alignment.

Reporting Line

Reports directly to the CEO.

This role has strategic influence across fundraise, product positioning, and external communications.

Role Type

Full-time, long-term strategic hire.

We are building infrastructure for the next era of work.

Narrative discipline is part of that build.

description:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

  • 4-7 years of experience in application integration.

  • At least 3 years of experience in SQL/ETL.

  • Experience in gathering requirements, securing data flows (GDPR compliance), documenting deliverables, and participating in architecture and data reviews.
  • Fluent in English (Expert level) and French are a plus.
  • Available to realocate to Portugal and work in hybrid setting in Lisbon.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;

  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
About Able

Able is the AI front office for Wholesale Plumbing, HVAC, and Electrical Suppliers. We're automating the soul-crushing manual work that buries inside sales teams - starting with fixture quoting.


The Wholesale Supply market is a $350B+ market running on spreadsheets and tribal knowledge. We're building the infrastructure to change that.


About the Role

Founding Engineer, with a focus on shipping Agents. You'll spec features, debug weird edge cases, scale infrastructure and help us figure out what to build next based on what customers actually need.

We're not looking for someone who needs a roadmap handed to them. We're looking for somebody who wants to help build the roadmap. If you see a problem, you fix it. If you don't know something, you learn it.


What we're looking for

  • 3 to 5 years of Software Engineering experience
  • Backend depth — you're comfortable owning a Python/FastAPI service end-to-end, from async request handling to data modeling to production debugging
  • Agent & LLM Fluent - you understand how agentic systems work and the failure modes that arise
  • Cloud comfortable - GCP, Firestore, Pub/Sub, Vercel, & Docker. You don't need to be an infra specialist but you shouldn't be scared of it
  • Document intelligence - comfortable working with document parsing & extraction pipelines (OCR, layout analysis, structured extraction, etc)


You're Likely a Fit If

  • You've designed, built, and shipped something with LLMs or Agents with real users
  • You're comfortable making decisions and backing up your logic
  • You default to shipping over planning. Iteration > Perfection
  • You've worked in an early-stage company before and are ready for the chaos

description:
About UserGuiding


UserGuiding is a leader in the digital adoption field and has earned a 'Best Software' placement on G2 for two consecutive years. We work with globally recognized companies such as TOTVS, WEG, Caju, Wolters Kluwer, DigitalOcean, and Philip Morris International.


Role Objective


UserGuiding is looking for a results-driven, trilingual Account Executive to spearhead our growth across the Americas. Your primary mission is to lead our expansion in the Brazilian market, while also capturing opportunities in North America and Spanish-speaking LATAM.


You will own the entire revenue pipeline for your region, serving as the primary point of contact for prospects from their first discovery call to their final signature.

2. Pipeline Generation & Outreach


  • Proactive Prospecting: Engage with high-intent signups and conduct outbound outreach to key decision-makers (Product People and UX Designers).
  • Event Advocacy: Attend and represent UserGuiding at major industry events and meetups in Brazil to build a self-sustaining pipeline.
  • Thought Leadership: Regularly share insights, product updates, and industry trends to build a personal brand that attracts inbound interest on LinkedIn.


3. Strategy & CRM Excellence


  • Market Insights: Feed local market trends and customer needs back to our Product and Marketing teams to help refine our messaging in the region.
  • Hubspot Management: Maintain 100% CRM accuracy, ensuring all deals are properly forecasted and followed up on.


Candidate Profile & Experience


  • Experience: 2–4 years of experience in a sales-centric role, with at least 1 year specifically as an Account Executive within a B2B SaaS startup.


Linguistic Versatility:


  • Portuguese: Native-level (Primary market focus).
  • English: Professional fluency (Internal coordination & North American deals).
  • Spanish: High proficiency (Managing Spanish-speaking LATAM territories).


  • Skills: Strong consultative selling skills, public speaking confidence, and the ability to navigate a \"no-code\" technical environment. We don’t want someone to show our playground in the first minute. Our sales calls should be in the interview format.


Tech Stack


  • Sales: Hubspot CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Apollo.io
  • Comm: Google Meet, Slack.


Compensation & Benefits


  • Base Salary: Competitive fixed monthly salary.
  • Variable Bonus: Uncapped quarterly bonuses based on New Business Revenue (NBR) and pipeline targets.
  • Impact: A high-autonomy role where you directly influence UserGuiding's global expansion strategy.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
About VEL

Civilization is shifting.

AI is no longer confined to the browser. Work is decentralizing. Cities are restructuring. Corporate real estate is contracting.

VEL is building Physical AI infrastructure — intelligent, distributed environments embedded into airports, commercial buildings, and urban nodes.

VEGA is what people experience. IRIS is the intelligence layer that governs it.

We are not building chat interfaces.

We are building embodied AI systems operating in real-world environments.


The Role

The Chief of Staff is the CEO’s strategic execution partner — responsible for converting executive intent into structured, measurable execution across the company.


You will operate across:

● Product (Physical AI systems)

● Fundraise and capital coordination

● Manufacturing partners

● Real estate and deployment strategy

● International expansion

● Board and investor communications


This is not an administrative role.

This is not calendar management.

This is a cross-functional force multiplier role embedded in high-velocity decision environments.


You will:

● Translate CEO strategy into executable workstreams

● Drive OKR cadence and operational rhythm

● Prepare board materials and investor updates

● Support capital raise execution and investor coordination

● Maintain discipline across execution systems (Monday.com, Miro, etc.)

● Identify risk early and enforce accountability

● Coordinate cross-border stakeholders

This role requires executive maturity, commercial literacy, and comfort operating in ambiguity.


Mandatory Qualifications (Non-Negotiable)

You must have:

● Minimum 3 years serving as Chief of Staff reporting directly to a CEO

● Experience in a venture-backed or high-growth environment

● Direct exposure to capital raise cycles

● Ownership of board-level documentation and reporting

● Financial literacy (runway, unit economics, forecasting inputs)

● Experience implementing structured execution systems

● Strong English communication

● Willingness to travel extensively

You Are Likely Coming From

● A venture-backed startup in growth stage

● An infrastructure, hardware, or deep-tech environment

● A company operating across multiple countries

● A high-velocity environment with capital exposure


You understand that:

● Execution discipline determines survival

● Capital alignment drives strategy

● Ambiguity is normal at scale-building companies

● Board-level communication must be precise

● Travel is part of building global infrastructure

You prefer ownership over supervision.

You are comfortable operating without detailed instructions.


Who Should Not Apply

● Executive Assistants repositioning as Chief of Staff

● Strategy consultants without operating accountability

● Candidates without capital exposure

● Individuals unwilling to travel 90–120 days per year

● Candidates seeking low-intensity environments

What We Offer

● Direct CEO exposure

● Global operational footprint

● Board-level experience

● Infrastructure-scale problem set

● Equity upside

● Responsibility for execution coherence across the company

We are building infrastructure for the next era of work.


Travel Requirement: 90–120 days per year (US, Europe, GCC)

This role requires regular international travel for investor engagement, manufacturing coordination, and deployment oversight. Candidates must be fully comfortable operating in a travel-intensive environment.


Compensation: $60,000–$85,000 USD + meaningful equity

Compensation will be aligned to experience, depth of operating exposure, and prior executive-level responsibility. Equity participation reflects the strategic importance of this role.


Reporting Line: Reports directly to the CEO

This is a senior strategic position with cross-functional authority across product, capital, manufacturing, and deployment.


Role Type: Full-time, long-term strategic hire

This is not a contract position. We are building foundational infrastructure and expect long-term ownership and accountability.

description:
Company Description

A XMX Corp é uma empresa de performance digital focada em escalar funis de vendas com base em dados e resultados reais. Atuamos com marketing direto, otimização de conversão e inteligência operacional para maximizar lucro e eficiência. Nosso principal foco é atrair e desenvolver afiliados de alta performance, fortalecendo nosso modelo B2B e ampliando escala. Valorizamos velocidade, adaptação e execução prática para crescer de forma consistente e sustentável.


RESPONSABILIDADES:
  • Estruturar modelos estatísticos para apoiar decisões estratégicas da empresa;
  • Aplicar métodos estatísticos avançados para análise de performance (funil, ofertas, backend, retenção, reembolso, churn);
  • Desenvolver modelos preditivos para:
  • Projeção de receita
  • Probabilidade de recompra
  • Tendência de reembolso
  • Lifetime Value (LTV)
  • Elasticidade de preço
  • Analisar experimentos e testes A/B com rigor estatístico
  • Criar modelos de atribuição e correlação entre variáveis de negócio;
  • Elevar o nível de confiabilidade dos dados e análises da empresa;
  • Identificar vieses, inconsistências e distorções nos dados;
  • Construir dashboards estratégicos com foco em tomada de decisão;
  • Apoiar diretoria na interpretação estatística de cenários e projeções;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Funil, Backend, Financeiro e Oferta para traduzir dados em estratégias práticas.
  • Organização de todos os testes que estão sendo feitos na empresa, documentação e análise.
QUALIFICAÇÕES:
  • Formação sólida em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Física ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio avançado de estatística descritiva e inferencial;
  • Conhecimento profundo em:
  • Probabilidade
  • Regressão
  • Testes de hipótese
  • Modelagem preditiva
  • Séries temporais
  • Análise multivariada

  • Conhecimento em Python (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Statsmodels ou similares);

title: Data Compression Engineer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


***

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Data Compression Engineer with deep experience in compression algorithms and high-performance systems.

You will work closely with the core engineering team to help analyze, validate, optimize, and productionize advanced lossless compression technology .

The ideal candidate is both technically rigorous and intellectually curious , capable of investigating unconventional approaches while applying strong systems engineering discipline.


Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze, implement, and optimize lossless compression algorithms
  • Evaluate novel compression techniques and validate performance claims through benchmarking and profiling
  • Improve compression ratio, throughput, latency, and memory efficiency across diverse file types
  • Design and optimize high-performance compression libraries and pipelines
  • Conduct algorithmic experimentation and critical validation of compression models
  • Develop benchmarking frameworks to evaluate performance across datasets and workloads
  • Collaborate with the core engineering team to productionize compression systems


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with strong focus on systems programming
  • Demonstrated experience working with data compression algorithms
  • Examples: LZ-family (LZ4, LZ77, LZMA), Huffman coding, arithmetic coding, Brotli, Zstandard, etc.
  • Strong understanding of: entropy encoding, algorithmic complexity, memory and CPU trade-offs, compression benchmarking
  • Proficiency in C, C++, Rust, or other high-performance systems languages
  • Experience with performance profiling and optimization
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking capabilities
  • Comfortable evaluating unconventional or experimental approaches to algorithm design


Nice to Have

  • Experience working at a major technology company, infrastructure company, or cloud provider
  • Background in high-performance computing, distributed systems, or storage systems
  • Experience implementing or optimizing compression codecs
  • Experience with GenAI or advanced software development workflows
  • Contributions to open-source compression libraries
  • Experience designing benchmarking frameworks for algorithm evaluation


Nice to Have

  • Experience working with large-scale distributed storage systems
  • Knowledge of columnar storage formats (Parquet, ORC)
  • Experience with streaming systems (Kafka, Pulsar)
  • Exposure to ML-based or adaptive compression techniques
  • Contributions to open-source compression libraries
  • Experience with SIMD, vectorization, or GPU acceleration


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams

title: Data Compression Engineer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


***

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Data Compression Engineer with deep experience in compression algorithms and high-performance systems.

You will work closely with the core engineering team to help analyze, validate, optimize, and productionize advanced lossless compression technology .

The ideal candidate is both technically rigorous and intellectually curious , capable of investigating unconventional approaches while applying strong systems engineering discipline.


Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze, implement, and optimize lossless compression algorithms
  • Evaluate novel compression techniques and validate performance claims through benchmarking and profiling
  • Improve compression ratio, throughput, latency, and memory efficiency across diverse file types
  • Design and optimize high-performance compression libraries and pipelines
  • Conduct algorithmic experimentation and critical validation of compression models
  • Develop benchmarking frameworks to evaluate performance across datasets and workloads
  • Collaborate with the core engineering team to productionize compression systems


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with strong focus on systems programming
  • Demonstrated experience working with data compression algorithms
  • Examples: LZ-family (LZ4, LZ77, LZMA), Huffman coding, arithmetic coding, Brotli, Zstandard, etc.
  • Strong understanding of: entropy encoding, algorithmic complexity, memory and CPU trade-offs, compression benchmarking
  • Proficiency in C, C++, Rust, or other high-performance systems languages
  • Experience with performance profiling and optimization
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking capabilities
  • Comfortable evaluating unconventional or experimental approaches to algorithm design


Nice to Have

  • Experience working at a major technology company, infrastructure company, or cloud provider
  • Background in high-performance computing, distributed systems, or storage systems
  • Experience implementing or optimizing compression codecs
  • Experience with GenAI or advanced software development workflows
  • Contributions to open-source compression libraries
  • Experience designing benchmarking frameworks for algorithm evaluation


Nice to Have

  • Experience working with large-scale distributed storage systems
  • Knowledge of columnar storage formats (Parquet, ORC)
  • Experience with streaming systems (Kafka, Pulsar)
  • Exposure to ML-based or adaptive compression techniques
  • Contributions to open-source compression libraries
  • Experience with SIMD, vectorization, or GPU acceleration


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.

In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
About VEL

Civilization is shifting.

AI is no longer confined to the browser. Work is decentralizing. Cities are restructuring. Corporate real estate is contracting.

VEL is building Physical AI infrastructure — intelligent, distributed environments embedded into airports, commercial buildings, and urban nodes.

VEGA is what people experience. IRIS is the intelligence layer that governs it.

We are not building chat interfaces.

We are building embodied AI systems operating in real-world environments.


The Role

The Chief of Staff is the CEO’s strategic execution partner — responsible for converting executive intent into structured, measurable execution across the company.


You will operate across:

● Product (Physical AI systems)

● Fundraise and capital coordination

● Manufacturing partners

● Real estate and deployment strategy

● International expansion

● Board and investor communications


This is not an administrative role.

This is not calendar management.

This is a cross-functional force multiplier role embedded in high-velocity decision environments.


You will:

● Translate CEO strategy into executable workstreams

● Drive OKR cadence and operational rhythm

● Prepare board materials and investor updates

● Support capital raise execution and investor coordination

● Maintain discipline across execution systems (Monday.com, Miro, etc.)

● Identify risk early and enforce accountability

● Coordinate cross-border stakeholders

This role requires executive maturity, commercial literacy, and comfort operating in ambiguity.


Mandatory Qualifications (Non-Negotiable)

You must have:

● Minimum 3 years serving as Chief of Staff reporting directly to a CEO

● Experience in a venture-backed or high-growth environment

● Direct exposure to capital raise cycles

● Ownership of board-level documentation and reporting

● Financial literacy (runway, unit economics, forecasting inputs)

● Experience implementing structured execution systems

● Strong English communication

● Willingness to travel extensively

You Are Likely Coming From

● A venture-backed startup in growth stage

● An infrastructure, hardware, or deep-tech environment

● A company operating across multiple countries

● A high-velocity environment with capital exposure


You understand that:

● Execution discipline determines survival

● Capital alignment drives strategy

● Ambiguity is normal at scale-building companies

● Board-level communication must be precise

● Travel is part of building global infrastructure

You prefer ownership over supervision.

You are comfortable operating without detailed instructions.


Who Should Not Apply

● Executive Assistants repositioning as Chief of Staff

● Strategy consultants without operating accountability

● Candidates without capital exposure

● Individuals unwilling to travel 90–120 days per year

● Candidates seeking low-intensity environments

What We Offer

● Direct CEO exposure

● Global operational footprint

● Board-level experience

● Infrastructure-scale problem set

● Equity upside

● Responsibility for execution coherence across the company

We are building infrastructure for the next era of work.


Travel Requirement: 90–120 days per year (US, Europe, GCC)

This role requires regular international travel for investor engagement, manufacturing coordination, and deployment oversight. Candidates must be fully comfortable operating in a travel-intensive environment.


Compensation: $60,000–$85,000 USD + meaningful equity

Compensation will be aligned to experience, depth of operating exposure, and prior executive-level responsibility. Equity participation reflects the strategic importance of this role.


Reporting Line: Reports directly to the CEO

This is a senior strategic position with cross-functional authority across product, capital, manufacturing, and deployment.


Role Type: Full-time, long-term strategic hire

This is not a contract position. We are building foundational infrastructure and expect long-term ownership and accountability.

title: Analista de Administração Pessoal e Benefícios Junior
description:
Responsável por assegurar a correta administração dos processos de ponto, benefícios e apoio aos cálculos de folha de pagamento, garantindo conformidade legal, acuracidade das informações e cumprimento de prazos. Atuará no controle e conferência de dados trabalhistas, apoiando a consistência dos lançamentos, mitigação de riscos e melhoria contínua dos processos de administração de pessoal.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Realizar a gestão e conferência do controle de ponto eletrônico, tratando inconsistências, banco de horas, horas extras, afastamentos e escalas.
  • Garantir cumprimento de prazos legais e obrigações acessórias relacionadas à compra, cadastro e disponibilização dos benefícios.
  • Atuar na interface com fornecedores de folha e benefícios, assegurando qualidade e precisão das informações.
  • Apoiar o processamento da folha de pagamento, realizando conferências prévias, validação de eventos e suporte aos cálculos trabalhistas.
  • Administrar benefícios (vale-transporte, vale-refeição/alimentação, plano de saúde, seguro, entre outros), incluindo movimentações, inclusões, exclusões e conferências de faturas.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e controles internos relacionados aos benefícios.
  • Apoiar o controle e cálculo de férias, 13º salário, admissões, desligamentos e encargos sociais.


Formação e Conhecimentos

  • Nível superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Gestão de RH ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em administração de pessoal e rotinas de folha de pagamento.
  • Vivência com controle de ponto eletrônico e gestão de benefícios.
  • Conhecimento de legislação trabalhista e encargos sociais.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado.
  • Desejável experiência com sistemas de folha e e-Social.

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
About the role:

The Demand Generation Manager is responsible for ensuring that clients receive high-quality marketing execution that drives measurable results. Whether through points our hours, this role ensures work is delivered efficiently and transparently based on each client’s contract.

This role requires strong strategic thinking, project management, and client relationship skills to ensure marketing initiatives are effectively planned, executed, and optimized. You will act as the primary contact for clients, overseeing campaign execution, aligning resources, and ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.

As an Account Manager , you’ll be responsible for translating client goals into actionable deliverables , managing project priorities, and ensuring each initiative aligns with their business objectives.


Key Responsibilities:Client Strategy & Execution

● Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment on objectives.

● Guide quarterly strategy calls , translating business goals into structured marketing initiatives.

● Define and prioritize client deliverables , ensuring efficient execution.

● Proactively provide strategic insights and recommendations to enhance marketing performance.

Project & Resource Management

● Oversee the execution of marketing campaigns , coordinating with Specialists to achieve desired results.

● Monitor progress on deliverables , ensuring projects stay within the allocated scope.

● Manage deadlines, approvals, and revisions , ensuring seamless project completion.

● Work with internal teams to optimize workflows and improve efficiency in marketing execution.

Performance & Optimization

● Track and analyze marketing performance , identifying areas for optimization.

● Collaborate with channel heads and Account Directors to ensure high quality deliverables get produced and contribute to client goals.

● Regularly review client satisfaction and engagement , proactively addressing potential issues.

● Identify opportunities for upselling additional services that align with client needs.

● Collaborate with the Growth Manager to ensure high client retention and continued success.

Success Metrics

In this role, you’ll be accountable for the following key performance indicators:

● Client point burden , ensuring each client remains on track based on the amount of points/hours purchased.

● Client goals, ensuring we are hitting the pre-defined targets set forth to define specific outcomes from the engagement


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in-house in B2B digital marketing or demand generation, ideally within software and technology.
  • Hands-on experience managing paid media channels and optimizing digital performance.
  • Strong understanding of funnel metrics, digital attribution models, and revenue-oriented KPIs.
  • Excellent project management skills; capable of managing internal projects and multiple external vendors.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a solid grasp of attribution models and proficiency in tools like Google Analytics, DreamData, or similar.
  • Familiarity with technical tools like Google Tag Manager, and Optimizely or VWO.
  • The ability to self-direct and self-start and work independently as well as within and across teams.
  • Hands-on experience in using marketing automation technology (HubSpot) and CRM (HubSpot).
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.
  • C1 or C2 English proficiency level.
  • CV and LinkedIn profile in English showcasing experience in chronological order.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Prior experience in a growth-stage or scale-up SaaS business.
  • Familiarity with content personalization, dynamic content, or account-based web experiences.
  • Experience with SQL or business intelligence tools (e.g., Domo, Looker, Tableau, etc.).

title: Senior Media Buyer | Stealth Manager
description:
Senior Media Buyer (Lead Generation & Patient Acquisition) | 100% remote


About the Role

We are hiring a senior-level performance marketer to own strategy, execution, and optimization of multi-account paid media campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking for local healthcare providers. This is a hands-on, high-accountability role managing complex campaign portfolios across Meta Ads and Google Ads.

This position is best suited for operators who are deeply analytical, comfortable managing scale, and experienced in service-based lead generation (not ecommerce).


What You Will Own

  • Full-funnel paid media strategy for local lead generation campaigns
  • Campaign build, optimization, and scaling across multiple client accounts
  • Budget allocation, audience strategy, creative testing, and performance improvement
  • Lead quality analysis and conversion performance optimization
  • Performance reporting, insights, and strategic recommendations
  • Continuous testing of messaging, offers, and conversion drivers


Must-Have Experience

  • 5+ years managing Meta Ads AND Google Ads professionally
  • Proven experience generating leads for local or service-based businesses
  • Demonstrated success managing multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Hands-on optimization experience focused on CPL and conversion quality
  • Experience with appointment-based funnels (consultations, bookings, or patient acquisition)
  • Strong analytical decision-making based on performance data


Strongly Preferred

  • Healthcare or chiropractic marketing experience
  • Experience managing 15+ accounts concurrently
  • Advanced understanding of local advertising and geographic targeting
  • Experience working in agency environments
  • Clear, professional spoken English for client-adjacent collaboration

title: Parceria Comercial
description:
Sobre nós

Somos uma consultoria de Recursos Humanos em fase inicial de operação, com foco em oferecer soluções estratégicas para empresas de pequeno, médio e grande porte. Atuamos com serviços de:

  • Recrutamento e Seleção
  • Treinamento e Desenvolvimento
  • Estruturação e Implantação de RH
  • Organização de processos e gestão de pessoas


Estamos estruturando nossa área comercial e buscamos profissionais com perfil empreendedor para atuar como Parceiros Comerciais.


Modelo de atuação

Buscamos profissionais da área comercial para atuar na prospecção ativa de clientes (empresas), apresentando nossas soluções de RH e gerando novas oportunidades de negócio.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Prospecção ativa de empresas (pequeno, médio e grande porte)
  • Abertura e qualificação de novas oportunidades comerciais
  • Apresentação consultiva dos serviços da empresa
  • Agendamento de reuniões estratégicas
  • Construção e manutenção de relacionamento com decisores
  • Identificação de demandas e oportunidades na área de RH


Perfil desejado

  • Experiência prévia na área comercial (B2B será diferencial)
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de negociação
  • Perfil consultivo e orientado a resultados
  • Organização, autonomia e disciplina comercial
  • Desejável carteira ativa de contatos empresariais


Oferecemos

  • Modelo de parceria flexível - Recebendo % dos contratos fechados
  • Possibilidade de crescimento junto com a expansão da consultoria


Remuneração

A remuneração será baseada em percentual (%) sobre os contratos fechados, conforme modelo de comissionamento a ser apresentado durante a formalização da parceria.

title: Tech Lead | Acquirer - Clearing & Settlement
description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro


A Getnet é uma empresa global de tecnologia especializada em soluções de pagamento para o comércio. Fundada no Brasil e presente na América Latina e na Península Ibérica, apoiamos mais de 1,3 milhão de comerciantes com serviços completos — da maquininha ao e-commerce.

Fazemos parte da PagoNxt , a fintech global do Grupo Santander, e atuamos como um hub de adquirência com forte presença em Espanha, Portugal, Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai .

Nossa missão é clara: simplificar os pagamentos com inovação, segurança e escala , ajudando negócios de todos os tamanhos a crescer com agilidade.

Oferecemos uma plataforma unificada que integra hardware, software, prevenção à fraude, adquirência, conciliação e serviços financeiros — tudo em um só ecossistema, para que nossos clientes possam focar no crescimento do seu negócio.

Fazer parte da Getnet é se juntar a uma empresa que combina a inovação de uma fintech com a solidez de um banco global.


Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.

Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza.

Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.

✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?


O que você vai fazer


O Tech Lead será responsável por liderar tecnicamente o time de desenvolvimento que atua em sistemas de processamento de produtos core (crédito, débito, vouchers). Este profissional deverá atuar como um facilitador, promovendo o alinhamento técnico entre os membros da equipe e assegurando que as soluções atendam aos padrões de qualidade, alta performance e tolerância a falhas. Além disso, será fundamental na orientação da equipe na adoção de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Principais responsabilidades:

• Orientação Técnica: Fornecer liderança técnica ao time de desenvolvimento, assegurando que as melhores práticas sejam seguidas em todos os aspectos do desenvolvimento de software.

• Garantia de Qualidade: Colaborar na definição e implementação de processos de automação de testes, supervisionando a qualidade do código e contribuindo para a redução de bugs.

• Colaboração Interfuncional: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Engineering Manager e os interlocutores de produtos para garantir que as entregas atendam às necessidades do negócio e estão alinhadas com as diretrizes técnicas.

• Mentoria e Desenvolvimento de Habilidades: Atuar como mentor para os membros da equipe, promovendo o desenvolvimento contínuo das habilidades técnicas e incentivando a adoção de novas tecnologias e metodologias.

• Resolução de Problemas Técnicos: Ser o ponto de referência para a resolução de problemas técnicos complexos e contribuir na definição de soluções inovadoras.

• Planejamento e Priorização: Auxiliar no planejamento e priorização das tarefas do time, garantindo a entrega das funcionalidades dentro do cronograma estabelecido.


✅ O que buscamos em você

• Ensino superior completo;

• Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações back-end utilizando, com familiaridade em frameworks como Spring Boot.

• Ter trabalhando com sistemas de processamento de adquirência

• Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.

• Experiência no uso de mensageria para criação de soluções escaláveis e resilientes.

• Aplicação de design patterns e boas práticas de desenvolvimento visando excelência na entrega de software.

Conhecimentos Funcionais Esperados:

• Clearing

• Liquidação



✅ O que pode contar pontos a mais

• Inglês e ou espanhol.


O que oferecemos

title: England Packaging Salesperson, Remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.

Role Description

We are seeking an experienced English Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into English markets, with a strong understanding of English business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.

Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.

Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be responsible for:

- Developing and maintaining relationships with English cosmetic and personal care brands

- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within England's cosmetic packaging market

- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements

- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting

- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction

- Meeting and exceeding sales targets

- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in English cosmetic packaging markets

Qualifications

- Proven track record of successful B2B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries

- Extensive experience working with English cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers

- Strong knowledge of English cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements

- Fluent in English

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

- Ability to travel to England as needed (20-30% of the time)

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field

- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools

- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: UI/UX Designer (Part-Time)
description:
We are looking for a part-time, remote UI/UX Designer with 6+ years in UI/UX or Product Design to to partner closely with the Product and Engineering teams to elevate usability, visual consistency, and user experience across the platforms of our U.S. client. You will work 10 hours per week in a hands-on role supporting new feature design, workflow improvements, and visual system enhancements across the SaaS products. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in B2B software environments, translating product requirements into thoughtful user experiences, and collaborating with crossfunctional teams.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers delivering market-leading field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land software solutions. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Design intuitive user experiences for complex SaaS workflows and data-heavy applications
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs
  • Partner with Product Managers and Engineers to shape feature concepts and interaction patterns
  • Apply and extend existing design systems and component libraries
  • Conduct lightweight user research or usability testing when needed
  • Iterate quickly based on stakeholder feedback and technical constraints
  • Ensure designs align with accessibility and usability best practices
  • Prepare assets and specs for smooth handoff to engineering


Requirements

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 6+ years in UI/UX or Product Design, with significant experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise software
  • Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end design work on data-intensive systems (dashboards, tables, grids, reporting tools, multi-step workflows)
  • Experience designing for multi-role environments with interconnected user workflows
  • Experience collaborating closely with product and engineering to navigate technical constraints and trade-offs
  • Proficiency with design tools
  • Familiarity with design systems and component-driven product development
  • Ability to work independently within a limited-hours engagement
  • Clear communicator who can explain design decisions to technical and non-technical partners


Desired Expereince

  • Bachelors degree in computer science or engineering
  • Experience in energy, finance, accounting, or other regulated/operational industries


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: PESSOA COORDENADORA DE CIÊNCIA DE DADOS - REMOTO
description:
Descrição da vaga

A SOMOS Educação é um dos principais grupos de educação básica do Brasil, oferecendo uma ampla variedade de soluções educacionais. Nossos serviços incluem sistemas de ensino, editoras, soluções de ensino complementares e uma plataforma tecnológica de aprendizado digital e e-commerce. Com isso, nos apresentamos como parceiros integrais das escolas.


Entre as marcas que compõem o nosso grupo estão Anglo, PH, Plurall, Líder em Mim e outras. Nossa missão é transformar o ecossistema das escolas privadas, combinando educação e gestão de alta qualidade com base na neurociência e na tecnologia em larga escala. Além disso, buscamos liderar as escolas no processo de transformação digital, visando ser o principal agente de reinvenção da educação para o aluno e a escola do século XXI.


Para cumprir essa missão e entregar o melhor para as nossas escolas, baseamos nosso trabalho em valores fundamentais. Valorizamos a autonomia e o apoio, o bem-estar, a excelência, a liderança e a inovação em nossa rotina de trabalho. Somos o único grupo educacional classificado como uma das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar, Great Place to Work – GPTW.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Coordenar a equipe de tecnologia, garantindo a qualidade e integridade das informações;

- Realizar análise de dados, utilizando técnicas de Business Intelligence e Data Mining;

- Gerenciar o banco de dados e implementar soluções de Big Data;

- Liderar projetos de análise de dados e extração de insights;

- Resolver problemas relacionados à manipulação e interpretação de dados;

- Promover a comunicação eficaz entre a equipe e demais áreas da empresa.




Requisitos e qualificações:

- Graduação em Ciência da Computação

- Pós-graduação em Análise de Dados

- Certificação em Big Data

- Experiência comprovada em análise de dados e gestão de equipes

- Conhecimento em estatística e técnicas de Machine Learning

- Habilidade de liderança, trabalho em equipe e adaptabilidade

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas


O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.

  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Conexa: Atendimento psicológico gratuito para cuidar da sua saúde mental.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.


Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Parceria Comercial
description:
Sobre nós

title: Analista de Compliance (Jr)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.


Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!


São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!

Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Compliance (Jr) para se unir ao nosso Time de Compliance para:

  • Atualização de documentos requeridos pela certificação (Evidências de que os requerimentos PCI estão sendo cumpridos), visando conclusão do processo de auditoria de forma rápida e precisa;
  • Realização de atividades decorrentes das certificações das bandeiras (Visa, Mastercard e outros), visando cumprir com o exigido pela norma;
  • Auxílio na verificação da integridade de artefatos durante a fase inicial do projeto de certificação, a fim de reduzir desvios e atividades não previstas no curso do projeto;
  • Participação de projetos de certificação, interagindo com empresa terceira que realiza a auditoria, visando desembaraçar quaisquer entraves identificados no decorrer do projeto;
  • Organização de artefatos providos pelos círculos durante o projeto de certificação, visando manter uma base íntegra e rastreável de evidências;
  • Acompanhamento de reuniões técnicas com as demais áreas para discussão de temas referentes a evolução dos produtos;
  • Auxílio na execução dos treinamentos. (PCI, Segurança da Informação, LGPD e outros);
  • Disseminação das políticas e procedimentos de segurança HST;
  • Execução de processo de gestão de vulnerabilidades com os demais círculos envolvidos, visando elevar a segurança em todos os serviços e produtos da HST;
  • Execução de simulações de resposta a incidentes e continuidade de negócios, visando manter a resiliência da empresa em situações adversas.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

title: Engineering Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $8,500 - $10,000 USD


The Engineering Manager, Payments & Financial Infrastructure role is designed to own the technical systems responsible for money movement across their organization. At our partner, payments are not a support function. They are core product infrastructure. They advance funds to lab clients based on AI-driven claim valuation, reconcile against real insurance adjudication data, and manage complex settlement flows that must balance to the penny.


As transaction volume scales into hundreds of millions annually, the complexity of reliability, reconciliation, auditability, and compliance increases materially. This role exists to ensure they scale financial infrastructure with rigor, precision, and long-term architectural clarity. This is a player-coach leadership role, initially hands-on, evolving into team leadership and architectural stewardship of a dedicated payments engineering pod.


This role is accountable for:

  • Technical ownership of payment infrastructure and settlement systems
  • Reliability and correctness of all financial flows
  • Ledger and reconciliation architecture
  • Cross-team coordination for finance-critical systems
  • Building and leading a dedicated payments engineering pod


Key Responsibilities:


Payment Infrastructure Ownership

  • Own systems that disburse client advances, execute Treasury sweeps, process lockbox deposits, and generate settlement payments
  • Ensure all transactions reconcile precisely and remain fully auditable
  • Implement idempotency, monitoring, alerting, retry logic, and failure handling for payment-critical flows
  • Design workflows resilient to bank outages, ACH return codes, NSF events, and timing mismatches
  • Establish zero-error tolerance standards as volume scales


Ledger & Reconciliation Architecture

  • Design and evolve the internal ledger system tracking each receivable lifecycle from claim valuation to advance to adjudication to sweep to final settlement
  • Build reconciliation engines matching Payment Advances to ERA data
  • Automate weekly settlement calculations, including true-ups, clawbacks, and offsets
  • Ensure economic logic for Qualified vs. Non-Qualified claims is correctly implemented
  • Maintain strict auditability and financial traceability across systems


Cross-Team Collaboration & Platform Integration

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Data, Billing, and Clinical Platform teams
  • Ensure payment systems integrate cleanly with claim processing, ERA ingestion, and AI valuation systems
  • Partner with the Data team on financial reporting, reconciliation validation, and KPI consistency
  • Align with shared infrastructure standards including observability, deployment, security, and API governance
  • Actively participate in architecture discussions to prevent payment systems from becoming isolated silos


Payment infrastructure must operate as part of the broader platform, not adjacent to it.


Banking & Financial Partner Integration

  • Own integrations with banking partners and payment rails including ACH, EFT, and lockbox flows
  • Ensure client onboarding for Treasury Accounts and payment configuration is scalable and repeatable
  • Evaluate and integrate banking-as-a-service platforms and financial data providers
  • Maintain compliance with NACHA rules, treasury controls, and internal financial policies


Team Leadership & Engineering Standards

  • Hire and build a payments-focused engineering pod consisting of 2 to 3 engineers within 12 to 18 months
  • Define engineering standards for reliability, testing, deployment, and incident response
  • Establish operational playbooks for payment-critical systems
  • Partner closely with Payment Operations to ensure systems support real-world workflows
  • Balance hands-on contribution with leadership and long-term architectural planning


What This Role Is Not:

  • Not a purely operational finance role
  • Not a detached architecture-only leadership position
  • Not a payments API integration wrapper role


This is a systems-level ownership role where financial correctness, reliability, and architectural clarity are primary responsibilities.


What Success Looks Like:

  • All money movement is reliable, traceable, and auditable
  • Settlement logic is automated and predictable
  • Reconciliation discrepancies are rare and surfaced early
  • Banking integrations are standardized and repeatable
  • Payment-critical incidents decrease over time
  • Cross-team dependencies are clear and well-managed
  • A high-performing payments pod operates with strong engineering discipline


Ideal Background:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience
  • 3+ years building payment systems, financial infrastructure, or money movement platforms
  • Deep knowledge of ACH including NACHA rules, R-codes, batch construction, and prefunding
  • Experience designing ledger systems or reconciliation engines
  • Strong backend engineering experience including Python, Go, Java, or similar
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills
  • Experience operating payment-critical systems in production
  • Prior experience hiring or leading small engineering teams
  • Prior experience working at Nubank or in similar fintech companies


Strengths We Value:

  • Precision and rigor in financial system design
  • Systems thinking across multi-party money flows
  • Strong reliability mindset including observability, incident response, and recovery design
  • Clear, structured communication across engineering and finance stakeholders
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity while building durable architecture
  • High ownership and accountability


Why This Role Matters:

At our partner, money movement is core infrastructure, not an auxiliary capability.


Every advance, sweep, settlement, and reconciliation must be correct. As they scale into

hundreds of millions in annual volume, small architectural weaknesses compound into material financial risk.


This role ensures:

  • They scale financial infrastructure responsibly
  • They maintain trust with lab clients and banking partners
  • They prevent operational fragility as complexity grows
  • They build a durable foundation for future financial products


The Engineering Manager, Payments & Financial Infrastructure will help ensure that as they grow, their financial systems remain precise, resilient, and strategically aligned with the broader platform.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Clinical Research Associate (Oncology) – São Paulo (0.4 FTE, Rescue Study)


We are seeking an experienced Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to support a Phase 2 oncology rescue study in solid tumors. The role is part‑time (0.4 FTE) and based in São Paulo, with on‑site visits to the study site every 6–8 weeks.


Key Details

  • Therapeutic area: Oncology – solid tumor
  • Phase: 2
  • 1 year contract
  • Start date: ASAP


Responsibilities

  • Perform regular on‑site monitoring visits approximately every 6–8 weeks
  • Ensure protocol compliance, data quality, and patient safety in a rescue study setting
  • Complete source data verification and support data clean‑up and query resolution
  • Review and maintain essential documents and site files
  • Collaborate closely with site staff and the project team to address study issues and implement corrective actions as needed


Requirements

  • 4–5 years of experience as a CRA
  • Proven experience monitoring oncology clinical trials, ideally in solid tumors
  • Prior experience with Phase 2 studies preferred
  • Strong knowledge of ICH‑GCP and clinical research regulations
  • Based in São Paulo (or able to reliably travel to sites in São Paulo)
  • Able to start on short notice (ASAP)


If you meet the above criteria and are interested in supporting this Phase 2 oncology rescue study, please submit your CV and availability.

title: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking
description:
Brazilstrat is hiring: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking


Brazilstrat connects top-tier Brazilian remote talent with organizations abroad. We are currently selecting a Structural Engineer to join a US-based partner company.


In this role, you will work remotely performing structural analysis and design for projects including awnings and similar outdoor structures. This is an ideal position for an experienced engineer looking for flexible, project-based work with the potential to grow into a full-time role.


Key Responsibilities:

* Structural Analysis: perform detailed structural calculations and analysis for outdoor structures such as awnings.

* Design & Documentation: prepare structural drawings, specifications, and technical reports that meet international standards and client requirements.

* Software Modeling: use structural analysis software (SAP2000 or equivalent) to model loads, stresses, and structural behavior.

* Technical Collaboration: coordinate with architects, fabricators, and project managers to ensure structural integrity and constructability of designs.

* Quality Assurance: review designs for compliance with applicable building codes and engineering best practices.


Requirements:

* 3-5 years of experience in structural engineering, preferably with exposure to steel, aluminum, or lightweight structures.

* Advanced/Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory.

* Proficiency with structural analysis software such as SAP2000.

* Strong understanding of structural mechanics, load calculations, and material properties.

* Tech-savvy: comfortable with CAD tools, Excel for calculations, and modern productivity software. Experience using AI tools to increase efficiency is a plus.

* Detail-oriented with strong documentation and communication skills.

* Self-motivated and able to manage project timelines independently in a remote setting.


What We Offer:

* 100% remote, home-office flexibility.

* Flexible hours/project-based engagement to start, with potential to develop into a full-time position.

* Exposure to international projects and clients.

* Growth opportunities within a scaling global network.


How to Apply: Please complete our initial screening form here:


Only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $8,500 - $10,000 USD


The Engineering Manager, Payments & Financial Infrastructure role is designed to own the technical systems responsible for money movement across their organization. At our partner, payments are not a support function. They are core product infrastructure. They advance funds to lab clients based on AI-driven claim valuation, reconcile against real insurance adjudication data, and manage complex settlement flows that must balance to the penny.


As transaction volume scales into hundreds of millions annually, the complexity of reliability, reconciliation, auditability, and compliance increases materially. This role exists to ensure they scale financial infrastructure with rigor, precision, and long-term architectural clarity. This is a player-coach leadership role, initially hands-on, evolving into team leadership and architectural stewardship of a dedicated payments engineering pod.


This role is accountable for:

  • Technical ownership of payment infrastructure and settlement systems
  • Reliability and correctness of all financial flows
  • Ledger and reconciliation architecture
  • Cross-team coordination for finance-critical systems
  • Building and leading a dedicated payments engineering pod


Key Responsibilities:


Payment Infrastructure Ownership

  • Own systems that disburse client advances, execute Treasury sweeps, process lockbox deposits, and generate settlement payments
  • Ensure all transactions reconcile precisely and remain fully auditable
  • Implement idempotency, monitoring, alerting, retry logic, and failure handling for payment-critical flows
  • Design workflows resilient to bank outages, ACH return codes, NSF events, and timing mismatches
  • Establish zero-error tolerance standards as volume scales


Ledger & Reconciliation Architecture

  • Design and evolve the internal ledger system tracking each receivable lifecycle from claim valuation to advance to adjudication to sweep to final settlement
  • Build reconciliation engines matching Payment Advances to ERA data
  • Automate weekly settlement calculations, including true-ups, clawbacks, and offsets
  • Ensure economic logic for Qualified vs. Non-Qualified claims is correctly implemented
  • Maintain strict auditability and financial traceability across systems


Cross-Team Collaboration & Platform Integration

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Data, Billing, and Clinical Platform teams
  • Ensure payment systems integrate cleanly with claim processing, ERA ingestion, and AI valuation systems
  • Partner with the Data team on financial reporting, reconciliation validation, and KPI consistency
  • Align with shared infrastructure standards including observability, deployment, security, and API governance
  • Actively participate in architecture discussions to prevent payment systems from becoming isolated silos


Payment infrastructure must operate as part of the broader platform, not adjacent to it.


Banking & Financial Partner Integration

  • Own integrations with banking partners and payment rails including ACH, EFT, and lockbox flows
  • Ensure client onboarding for Treasury Accounts and payment configuration is scalable and repeatable
  • Evaluate and integrate banking-as-a-service platforms and financial data providers
  • Maintain compliance with NACHA rules, treasury controls, and internal financial policies


Team Leadership & Engineering Standards

  • Hire and build a payments-focused engineering pod consisting of 2 to 3 engineers within 12 to 18 months
  • Define engineering standards for reliability, testing, deployment, and incident response
  • Establish operational playbooks for payment-critical systems
  • Partner closely with Payment Operations to ensure systems support real-world workflows
  • Balance hands-on contribution with leadership and long-term architectural planning


What This Role Is Not:

  • Not a purely operational finance role
  • Not a detached architecture-only leadership position
  • Not a payments API integration wrapper role


This is a systems-level ownership role where financial correctness, reliability, and architectural clarity are primary responsibilities.


What Success Looks Like:

  • All money movement is reliable, traceable, and auditable
  • Settlement logic is automated and predictable
  • Reconciliation discrepancies are rare and surfaced early
  • Banking integrations are standardized and repeatable
  • Payment-critical incidents decrease over time
  • Cross-team dependencies are clear and well-managed
  • A high-performing payments pod operates with strong engineering discipline


Ideal Background:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience
  • 3+ years building payment systems, financial infrastructure, or money movement platforms
  • Deep knowledge of ACH including NACHA rules, R-codes, batch construction, and prefunding
  • Experience designing ledger systems or reconciliation engines
  • Strong backend engineering experience including Python, Go, Java, or similar
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills
  • Experience operating payment-critical systems in production
  • Prior experience hiring or leading small engineering teams
  • Prior experience working at Nubank or in similar fintech companies


Strengths We Value:

description:
O Cloud Architect será responsável por conduzir avaliações técnicas, definir estratégias de migração, criar arquiteturas alvo e liderar a execução do plano proposto. Atuará como referência técnica para o time, garantindo alinhamento com padrões de arquitetura, governança e boas práticas da AWS.

-Familiaridade com ambientes on-premises (virtualização, redes, storage).

-Domínio de ferramentas de migração e discovery (ex: RV Tools, AWS Migration Evaluator, AWS Application Migration Service).

-Pensamento analítico e visão estratégica.
