Preferred

  • ServiceNow CTA, CIS, or CAD certifications.
  • Experience with AI/GenAI integrations and Agile/SAFe methodologies.
  • Leadership of scrum teams and collaboration with external vendors.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps.


Key Attributes

  • Architectural thinking and problem‑solving.
  • Strong technical leadership and quality focus.
  • Executive presence with excellent communication skills.
  • Collaborative and adaptable in dynamic environments.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% annually.

title: Clinical Trial Associate II
description:
Clinical Trial Associate II


Resumo da Posição

O Clinical Trial Associate II desempenha um papel fundamental de suporte no planejamento, execução e encerramento de estudos clínicos nacionais e internacionais, com crescente autonomia e independência operacional. Com base em experiências prévias em operações de estudos clínicos, espera-se que o CTA II gerencie proativamente a documentação e os processos principais, identifique e resolva desafios operacionais, e atue como um ponto de coordenação confiável entre as equipes de estudo, fornecedores e centros de pesquisa. Este cargo também contribui para melhorias de processos e apoia a equipe na preparação para auditorias e inspeções.


Principais Responsabilidades:

• Fornecer suporte operacional para a execução bem-sucedida dos estudos clínicos, do desenvolvimento do protocolo até o encerramento do estudo, em conformidade com as Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e normas regulatórias internacionais.

• Gerenciar de forma independente os controles dos estudos clínicos, incluindo acompanhamento de documentos regulatórios, progresso de start-up, métricas de recrutamento, registros de faturas/pagamentos e desempenho de fornecedores, assegurando precisão, consistência e atualizações em tempo hábil.

• Coordenar reuniões de estudos clínicos (internas e externas), incluindo preparação de agendas, logística dos encontros e atas detalhadas com ações de acompanhamento.

• Apoiar a supervisão de fornecedores e CROs, acompanhando entregas, identificando lacunas ou riscos e comunicando-os preventivamente aos Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs).

• Auxiliar na preparação e submissão de documentos para Comitês de Ética/Comissões de Ética (IRB/EC) e para órgãos regulatórios, com papel ampliado na gestão de prazos e controle de qualidade.

• Realizar revisões contínuas do Trial Master File (TMF) e reconciliações; liderar atividades de controle de qualidade de documentos com supervisão mínima e contribuir ativamente para o planejamento de prontidão para inspeções.

• Coordenar e acompanhar a logística de equipamentos e suprimentos dos estudos clínicos junto a fornecedores e centros.

• Colaborar com CTMs e demais áreas para promover melhorias contínuas de processos e contribuir para atualizações de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (SOP) e instruções de trabalho.

• Assumir responsabilidade por projetos especiais e iniciativas transversais que exijam iniciativa, pensamento analítico e discernimento para resolver problemas.


Qualificações

• Graduação preferencialmente nas áreas de Ciências Biológicas ou Saúde.

• Inglês Fluente

• Conhecimento prático demonstrado das diretrizes ICH-GCP e normas regulatórias aplicáveis; experiência prévia no suporte a TMF, CTMS e atividades de controle de qualidade documental é obrigatória.

• Fortes habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação escrita; confortável em interagir com áreas como Garantia da Qualidade, Gerenciamento de Dados, Bioestatística, Segurança e Suprimentos Clínicos.

• Capacidade de antecipar as necessidades da equipe, tomar iniciativa e propor soluções em um ambiente dinâmico.

• Confortável em lidar com dados sensíveis, exercendo discrição adequada.


Contratação no regime PJ, posição remota com disponibilidade para viagens internacionais conforme necessidade.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior (Governança e GRC)
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!


Dia a dia:

Foco: Governança, Riscos, Controles e Regulamentações

Atuar de forma estratégica no fortalecimento da governança de Segurança da Informação, assegurando aderência a regulamentações, frameworks e normas aplicáveis (LGPD, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/27002, NIST, entre outras), promovendo gestão eficaz de riscos, controles internos e conformidade regulatória em alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Governança e Compliance

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Garantir aderência a frameworks como ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF, CIS Controls e PCI DSS.
  • Apoiar e conduzir auditorias internas e externas.
  • Atuar na sustentação de certificações e avaliações regulatórias.
  • Apoiar o programa de adequação e sustentação à LGPD.
  • Apoiar na avaliação de Privacy by Design e Security by Design.


Gestão de Riscos e Controles

  • Conduzir análises de riscos de segurança (técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios).
  • Definir, implementar e monitorar controles internos de segurança.
  • Avaliar riscos de terceiros e fornecedores críticos.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento de riscos e acompanhar sua execução.
  • Manter matriz de riscos atualizada e integrada à estratégia corporativa.


Regulamentações e Normas

  • Atuar nos temas relacionados a PCI DSS.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios (LGPD, normas contratuais).
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos e processuais aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.


Integração com Áreas Internas

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança.
  • Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.


Perfil Esperado

  • Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de priorização baseada em risco.
  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e elevar maturidade organizacional.
  • Mentalidade colaborativa e orientada a governança preventiva.


Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC).
  • Vivência com ISO 27001/27002 e/ou NIST.
  • Experiência em auditorias e avaliação de controles.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de riscos corporativos.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações como: CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 LA/LI, PCI ISA.
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência com PCI DSS
  • Experiência com ferramentas de GRC.


Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Evolução do nível de maturidade em segurança.
  • Redução de riscos críticos.
  • Aderência comprovada a PCI DSS e demais normas.
  • Redução de não conformidades em auditorias.
  • Fortalecimento da cultura de governança e controles.


Contexto de Atuação

A posição integra o White Team, com foco em governança, prevenção, controles e maturidade do programa de Segurança da Informação, atuando de forma estratégica e transversal com múltiplas áreas de negócio.

title: Executive Search Consultant
description:
About Gold & Aron:

Gold & Aron Conseil is a boutique executive search firm with a 20+ year track record of placing top-tier talent in the Technology and Financial Services industries across the Americas and Europe.


About the Role

We are hiring an Executive Search Senior Associate to support Gold & Aron CEO and COO across high-impact searches in Technology and Financial Services in a premium boutique environment. The role blends deep research, pipeline development, and end-to-end recruiting for select mid-level roles. You’ll help build the engine that enables leadership to focus on client strategy and firm growth.


WHAT YOU WILL DO


Candidate Research & Sourcing for senior level searches (60%)

  • Build and manage strong candidate pipelines across multiple concurrent searches.
  • Active search: Conduct structured research, market mapping using several tech tools including Linkedin, AI tools and own data base.
  • Passive search: Source, screen applicants
  • Lead candidate scoring, initial candidate assessment


End to end Recruiting for selected mid level searches (30%)

  • Build and manage candidate pipeline
  • Conduct first-round screens to assess fit and motivation.
  • Prepare concise candidate summaries and search updates.
  • Support client communications and progress check-ins.
  • Coordinate interviews and every other step of the hiring process.


Business Development Support (10%)

  • Research companies, markets, and potential clients
  • Build prospect lists and market intelligence for the CEO and COO.
  • Bring new ideas, new BD initiatives for the company


IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 3–7+ years in research, consulting, finance, tech, recruiting, or similar fields.
  • Experience in or recruiting for Tech or Financial Services is a strong plus.
  • Advanced English + Native Portuguese is a must. Spanish is a strong plus.
  • Analytical, structured thinker with strong organization and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; bias for action; strong ownership mindset.
  • Bachelor’s degree mandatory.
  • Location: Brazil remote. Preference for São Paulo, SP.

title: Business Development Manager (FX/CFD)
description:
D Prime is a globally recognized online broker, empowering professional investors with access to multi-asset CFD trading across global markets. With operational hubs in Dallas, London, Sydney, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Dubai, we combine advanced technology with deep industry expertise to deliver a seamless trading experience. We operate under multiple reputable financial licenses, including regulation by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), US SEC and FINRA, Australia’s ASIC, as well as authorities in Seychelles, Mauritius, and Vanuatu, ensuring strong compliance, transparency, and investor protection worldwide.


We are looking for a proactive and results-oriented Business Development Manager who will be responsible for expanding our client base, strengthening partnerships, and promoting our trading solutions across markets. This role requires strong knowledge of the online trading industry and the ability to convert opportunities into long-term business relationships.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop new and existing markets and client base, promote our trading solutions
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, IBs, and affiliates
  • Identify client trading needs and propose suitable brokerage services, platforms, and solutions
  • Effectively communicate the company’s value proposition, trading conditions, platforms, and partnership programs
  • Research sales statistics and assess growth opportunities within target markets
  • Maintain accurate records of leads, partners, and clients within the CRM system
  • Coordinate with internal departments (Dealing, Compliance, Marketing, Support) to ensure high service standards and client satisfaction
  • Conduct presentations, webinars, and platform demonstrations to prospective clients and partners


Key Requirements


  • Proven experience in Business Development / Sales within a CFD / Forex Brokerage
  • Strong understanding of FX, CFDs, trading platforms (e.g., MT4/MT5), and brokerage operations
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Experience working with CRM systems and managing sales pipelines
  • Existing network of traders, IBs, or affiliates is a strong advantage
  • Ability to analyze market trends and identify revenue opportunities
  • Target-driven mindset with experience working toward KPIs and revenue goals

title: Product Owner
description:
Como Product Owner, você será responsável por conduzir processos de descoberta, ideação e validação  das funcionalidades do produto, transformando necessidades em soluções claras e priorizadas. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). The Role

You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)

title: Gerente de Engenharia
description:
Empresa consolidada do setor de engenharia e construção civil busca Gerente de Engenharia para assumir papel estratégico na gestão técnica e operacional das obras, atuando como elo entre Diretoria, coordenações, engenheiros de obra, clientes e demais stakeholders.

Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar tecnicamente as obras, assegurando o cumprimento de contratos, prazos, custos, qualidade e segurança.
  • Liderar e desenvolver coordenadores e engenheiros de obra, promovendo atuação técnica consistente e tomada de decisão responsável.
  • Planejar, acompanhar e controlar o andamento das obras por meio de indicadores, relatórios e ferramentas de gestão.
  • Atuar no planejamento e controle de custos, analisando desvios e propondo soluções técnicas e financeiras.
  • Participar ativamente do processo de orçamento de obras: análise de projetos, levantamento de quantitativos, composição de custos, curva ABC, BDI e apoio à elaboração de propostas técnico-comerciais.
  • Acompanhar negociações com clientes, fornecedores, projetistas, concessionárias e órgãos públicos, quando necessário.
  • Atuar no relacionamento técnico com clientes industriais, comerciais e imobiliários, participando de reuniões e tratativas relacionadas à execução das obras.
  • Apoiar processos de contratação e negociação com terceirizados, dentro das alçadas definidas.
  • Propor melhorias, inovações e ajustes nos processos de engenharia, com embasamento técnico e foco em resultados sustentáveis.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Civil .

title: Executivo(a) de Contas
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Executivo(a) de Contas Sênior – Remoto


Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 28 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Executivo(a) de Contas . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Disponibilidade para idas pontuais ao escritório e visitas a clientes, caso seja do RJ ou SP;
  • Experiência no setor de Utilities & Energia ;
  • Sólida experiência em vendas diretas consultivas, com histórico comprovado na prospecção de novos clientes e no posicionamento de ofertas de transformação digital;
  • Vivência com modernização de aplicações, desenvolvimento de software, automação de processos, serviços de AMS (Application Management Services), alocação de profissionais e licenciamento de software;
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas de serviços de TI, com histórico consistente de abertura de novos clientes e sólida atuação na gestão de contas da base instalada, com foco em relacionamento, crescimento e superação de metas;
  • Perfil hunter, com mentalidade empreendedora, alta energia e resiliência;
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação executiva e negociação em contas enterprise;
  • Conhecimento prático sobre propostas de valor em transformação digital, abrangendo projetos, AMS, sustentação, alocação de profissionais e licenciamento de software;
  • Experiência no uso de CRM (preferencialmente Microsoft Dynamics) para gestão de pipeline, forecast e controle de vendas;
  • Habilidade em storytelling e construção de business cases;
  • Formação superior completa, preferencialmente em Administração, Engenharia, TI ou áreas correlatas; pós-graduação ou MBA será considerado um diferencial;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado desejável, para atuação em oportunidades com fabricantes e parceiros.


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar novas contas, identificando e acessando decisores em empresas enterprise por meio de abordagem consultiva e rede de relacionamentos;
  • Gerenciar todo o ciclo de vendas, desde o primeiro contato até a negociação final e fechamento do contrato;
  • Construir relacionamentos estratégicos com executivos de negócios e tecnologia, atuando como parceiro de transformação digital;
  • Elaborar e apresentar propostas de valor, business cases e apresentações executivas personalizadas às necessidades do cliente;
  • Conduzir negociações com foco em geração de valor, margem e sustentabilidade do relacionamento;
  • Coordenar a transição para as equipes de entrega, garantindo o onboarding adequado de novos clientes;
  • Atualizar e gerenciar o pipeline no CRM, mantendo dados de oportunidades, previsões e atividades de vendas;
  • Monitorar o mercado e a concorrência, identificando tendências e propondo estratégias de diferenciação para a Sys Manager;
  • Colaborar com equipes internas de pré-vendas, marketing e Centros de Excelência (CoEs) na estruturação de propostas competitivas e de alto valor.


Nossos cuidados com você:

*Benefícios a variar de acordo com a modalidade de contrato


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição Ifood Empresas;

Benefício indireto (valor fixo para custeio parcial do plano de saúde ou somado ao vale alimentação);

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Sys Manager - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

title: Vendedor bilingue (Ingles)
description:
Descrição da Empresa Bright N’ Shine Pet Dental é uma empresa inovadora no setor de cuidados para animais de estimação, oferecendo um serviço especializado de limpeza dental cosmética móvel e não anestésica para gatos e cães nos Estados Unidos. Nosso modelo de negócio é sólido e estrategicamente projetado, com uma presença crescente no mercado de cuidados pet nos Estados Unidos. Valorizamos o trabalho de uma equipe altamente qualificada e buscamos constantemente excelência em nossos serviços. Junte-se a nós para fazer parte de um mercado sempre em expansão e fazer a diferença na saúde dos animais de estimação.

Descrição do Cargo Buscamos um vendedor bilingue (inglês) para atuar em nosso time. O profissional será responsável por identificar e prospectar novos clientes, atender e orientar clientes em potencial sobre os serviços oferecidos pela empresa, e estabelecer relações comerciais de longo prazo. Será necessário usar habilidades de comunicação em inglês e português de forma eficaz no atendimento ao cliente, garantindo uma experiência de alta qualidade. Este é um cargo remoto baseado em contrato.

Qualificações

  • Idiomas: Fluência em inglês e português é essencial para comunicação com diversos tipos de clientes.
  • Habilidades de vendas: Experiência em vendas e capacidade de alcançar metas, negociar e apresentar soluções personalizadas aos clientes.
  • Atendimento ao cliente: Comprometimento em oferecer um excelente atendimento ao cliente, com foco em criar um relacionamento de confiança e satisfação.
  • Será um diferencial ter experiência no uso de CRM, Tratamento de Leads.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
We are looking for a Backend Engineer with a strong focus on GoLang to join a cross-functional, solution-driven development team. You will play a key role in building new products, developing integrations, and continuously evolving our platform. If you enjoy building scalable services, writing clean and high-quality code, and working in a collaborative, impact-driven environment, this opportunity is for you.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate within a cross-functional team to design and deliver product-driven solutions;
  • Develop and implement new features, products, and platform integrations;
  • Build scalable, resilient web services and APIs using GoLang;
  • Maintain high-quality standards through code reviews, automated testing, and engineering best practices;
  • Identify and fix bugs while monitoring and optimizing application performance;
  • Contribute to aligning technical strategy with business objectives;
  • Produce clear and well-structured technical documentation;
  • Embody the team's values: ownership, innovation, collaboration, and customer empathy.


Technical Requirements

  • 3–5 years of professional software development experience;
  • Strong hands-on experience with GoLang for backend development;
  • Experience building scalable and fault-tolerant web services and APIs;
  • Familiarity with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases;
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services;
  • Knowledge of CI/CD tools (e.g., Concourse or similar);
  • Strong understanding of clean, testable, and maintainable code principles;
  • Experience with automated testing (unit and/or integration tests);
  • Strong communication skills to understand requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions;
  • Growth mindset: commitment to continuous improvement, proactive attitude, and strong sense of ownership.


What to Expect in the Day-to-Day

The role involves a balanced mix of:

  • New feature implementation;
  • Testing and validation;
  • Bug fixing and performance improvements;
  • Technical documentation.


Come and join the BEST IT TEAM!

title: Sénior C++ Architect (Relocation to Portugal)
description:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • +6 years significant experience with C++ (preferably C++11 or later);
  • Experience using GNU/Linux for development, shell scripting, and basic administration;
  • Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming languages and software architectures;
  • Solid understanding of distributed software architectures;
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal;
  • C1 English is mandatory.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote/on-site;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you:


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter endpoints REST utilizando FastAPI
  • Construir dashboards interativos usando React, Material UI e HighCharts
  • Consumir APIs e gerenciar estados complexos com React Query
  • Criar testes unitários e apoiar o processo de CI/CD
  • Validar dados e comportamento da UI junto às equipes de negócio e dados


O que você precisa ter

  • Inglês avançado para comunicação (Será testado)
  • Python e FastAPI
  • React e TypeScript
  • Snowflake ou Databricks
  • CI/CD


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Agilista Sênior
description:
Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros.


Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos!


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar no modelo 100% remoto, integrando o time de Tecnologia, com atuação estratégica e operacional, apoiando múltiplos times na evolução contínua das práticas, na melhoria do fluxo de trabalho e na geração de valor para o negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Implementar e escalar o método Kanban em diferentes áreas da empresa, respeitando o contexto e maturidade de cada equipe;
  • Construir e facilitar workshops, treinamentos e sessões práticas sobre Kanban, fluxo contínuo, métricas e melhoria evolutiva;
  • Apoiar líderes e Product Owners na gestão de fluxo, políticas explícitas, limites de WIP e cadência de reuniões;
  • Monitorar e analisar métricas como lead time, throughput, aging e CFD para orientar decisões e melhorias;
  • Atuar como mentor de times ágeis, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e foco em entrega de valor;
  • Conduzir assessments de maturidade e planos de evolução baseados em práticas Lean e Kanban.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Experiência como Scrum Master, Agile Master e/ou Service Delivery Manager atuando com mais de um time simultaneamente;
  • Experiência como Agile Coach, Kanban Coach e/ou Enterprise Agile Coach;
  • Experiência comprovada com o Método Kanban;
  • Experiência prática com Flight Levels;
  • Experiência e domínio de métricas ágeis: lead time, cycle time, throughput, simulação de Monte Carlo, CFD (Cumulative Flow Diagram) e histograma;
  • Experiência na facilitação de treinamentos, workshops, mentorias e cadências/ritos ágeis;
  • Experiência com técnicas e dinâmicas de Product Discovery, Design Thinking, Lean Inception e construção de MVP;
  • Experiência e conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Conhecimento em ServiceNow, Jira e Azure DevOps;
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de métricas como Nave, Power BI e Actionable Agile;

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Contract: PJ

Duration: Open-ended

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern cloud-native technologies while contributing to reliable, scalable systems across multi-cloud platforms.

This is a contract position , open to remote candidates located in North or South America , and will report to a Senior Manager of DevOps Engineering .


What You’ll Do

  • Participate in a regular on-call rotation , responding to incidents reliably and professionally
  • Maintain and evolve AWS cloud infrastructure , leveraging automation and infrastructure-as-code
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform
  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines , enabling agile and self-service software delivery
  • Manage and support containerized applications running on Kubernetes
  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineers and other DevOps team members to solve complex technical problems
  • Quickly absorb technical context while ramping up in a dynamic environment
  • Contribute to best practices that enhance system reliability, scalability, and performance


Minimum Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or a related role
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or GCP
  • Experience with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes
  • Experience with GitOps / CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • Exposure to logging, monitoring, and observability tools such as:
  • Datadog
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • ELK Stack
  • CloudWatch
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers working primarily in Pacific Time (PST)


Nice to Have

  • Experience developing automation or tooling using languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., Go, Python, Java, Elixir )
  • Experience building or supporting platform tooling for development, staging, or integration environments
  • Strong skills debugging performance or networking issues in Kubernetes-based applications
  • Familiarity with audit and compliance frameworks (SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS)
  • Working knowledge of UNIX/Linux operating systems
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

title: Senior Backend Engineer (.NET + Kubernetes + AI Accelerated Development)
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who thrives on using the latest and greatest backend technologies including .NET 10 and cloud-native patterns .


This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.


Our Backend Tech Stack

You’ll be working with a modern, cloud-native environment that includes:

  • .NET , .Net Core + EF (latest)
  • MySQL - primary transactional database
  • Amazon Redshift - analytics & reporting
  • Valkey (Redis) - high-performance caching
  • Kubernetes on AWS - service orchestration & scaling
  • Heavy use of AWS native services across compute, networking, messaging, and storage
  • Azure DevOps - CI/CD pipelines, deployments, automation
  • Microservices architecture following modern design patterns


What You Will Do

  • Build production-grade backend services using .NET 10 , .NET Core, and the latest EF features.
  • Design, build, and support microservices that are scalable, resilient, secure, and cloud-native.
  • Work across MySQL, Redshift, and Valkey (Redis) to support both transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Deploy and operate services in Kubernetes on AWS.
  • Own CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows in Azure DevOps .
  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code with a strong emphasis on unit testing and automated testing culture (TDD).
  • Collaborate with frontend, product, and AI teams to deliver features end-to-end.
  • Use AI-powered tools for code acceleration, debugging, test generation, refactoring, and documentation.
  • Contribute to shaping long-term system architecture with a path toward becoming a Solutions Architect / Principal Engineer .


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Strong backend experience with .NET / C# , and comfort with modern runtime features.
  • Experience with .NET Core , Entity Framework , and cloud-native backend development.
  • Solid understanding of microservices architecture , distributed system patterns, and clean coding principles.
  • Strong experience with unit testing and testable architecture.
  • If candidates cannot demonstrate real unit testing experience or passion, this role is not a good match.
  • Skilled in debugging, profiling, and optimizing backend systems.
  • Fluent English, comfortable with daily video-based communication.
  • Ability to work a full U.S. Pacific Time schedule.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Redshift or other analytical database systems.
  • Familiarity with AWS native services (SQS, SNS, Lambda, CloudWatch, IAM, etc.).
  • Experience with high-scale SaaS, data-heavy systems, or AI/ML integrations.
  • Experience with domain-driven design (DDD), event-driven patterns, or CQRS.


Who You Are

  • A self-motivated engineer with a passion for modern backend engineering.
  • Someone who enjoys working with the latest technologies , not legacy stacks.
  • A team player who cares about quality, testing, architecture, and long-term impact.
  • A builder who wants to grow into an architect and drive technical excellence.
  • A problem solver who takes ownership and thinks beyond task-level execution.
  • A strong believer in AI-accelerated development and continuous improvement.


Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building high-scale backend systems from the ground up. You’ll have the opportunity to define architectural foundations, build mission-critical services, and grow into a senior technical leader. Our stack gives you the chance to work with cutting-edge .NET technology, real cloud scale, and ambitious product challenges.

If you’re passionate about backend engineering, love modern .NET, and want to become a future architect, we’d love to talk.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

title: Finance Operations Manager
description:
Job Title: Finance & Operations Manager (Part-Time)

About the Company:

Our client is a fast-growing B2B software company providing enterprises, especially financial institutions, with a platform to accelerate innovation. The platform simplifies the discovery, validation, and scaling of vendors, tools, and data solutions, reducing the time, risk, and cost associated with adopting fintech solutions.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking a Finance & Operations Manager to work closely with the CFO and take ownership of day-to-day finance and selected operational responsibilities. This is a hands-on, number-two role within the finance function, ideal for someone who enjoys both detailed execution and contributing to strategic initiatives in a scaling environment. This position is part-time and fully remote.

Responsibilities:

• Lead and own the month-end close and bookkeeping processes.

• Consolidate multiple entities into a single, accurate set of accounts (essential requirement).

• Manage day-to-day accounts payable and receivable processes.

• Support the CFO with financial planning, KPI tracking, and preparation of investor materials.

• Maintain and update financial forecasts and cash flow models.

• Support international expansion initiatives from a finance and compliance perspective.

• Assist with operational responsibilities, including contributing to SOC 2 and ISO certification processes.

• Identify process improvements across Finance and Operations and implement practical solutions.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

• Proven experience consolidating multiple entities into one set of accounts.

• Strong experience leading month-end close processes and managing bookkeeping.

• Experience in fast-paced or high-growth environments.

• Strong attention to detail with a high level of reliability and diligence.

• Ability to work autonomously and balance multiple priorities effectively.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience maintaining and updating financial forecasts and cash flow models.

• Experience with cap table management software and compliance processes.

• Exposure to supporting audit, certification, or regulatory processes (e.g., SOC 2, ISO).

Personality:

• Hands-on and proactive, with a willingness to take ownership.

• Comfortable operating both at a detailed level and in strategic discussions.

• Flexible working style with strong organizational skills.

• Collaborative and adaptable in a scaling business environment.

Software & Tools:

• Accounting and bookkeeping software.

• Financial forecasting and cash flow modeling tools.

• Cap table management software.

• Compliance and certification tracking tools (SOC 2, ISO).

English Level:

C2

Schedule:

Part-Time UK Business Hours

Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the finance function within a high-growth company.

• Supportive and collaborative working environment.

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • 5+ years of professional experience as Software Developer;
  • 3+ years of professional experience with NodeJS;
  • 2 + years of professional experience with NextJS;
  • Fluency in English (mandatory);
  • Interest in working from Portugal (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Low-Code / No-Code Automation Manager (Fully Remote)
description:
About the Role


We’re looking for a Low-Code / No-Code Automation Manager  to lead the design, deployment, and scaling of business automations across the organization. This role sits at the intersection of operations, technology, and AI , with strong visibility to leadership and a clear growth path toward Director of Automation or Director of AI .


You’ll own our automation roadmap, turn manual processes into scalable systems, and help shape how AI is responsibly integrated into day-to-day work.


​​Type : Full-time, Fully Remote

Reports to:  CEO/Founder


What You'll Do:


  • Own and execute the automation strategy  across teams (Operations, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Support)
  • Design, build, and maintain low-code / no-code workflows  using tools like Zapier, Make, n8n, Airtable, Notion, Retool, or similar​
  • Introduce and manage AI-powered automations  (LLMs, AI agents, document processing, decision support)
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify high​-impact automation opportunities
  • Establish best practices, governance, documentation, and monitoring  for automations
  • Lead and mentor automation builders or citizen developers
  • Measure impact (time saved, cost reduction, scalability, quality improvements)
  • Advise leadership on AI and automation roadmap decisions


What We're Looking for:


Required

  • 4–7+ years experience in automation, operations, systems, or digital transformation
  • Strong hands-on experience with low-code / no-code tools
  • Proven ability to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions
  • Experience managing complex workflows, integrations, and edge cases
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical teams


Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI tools  (LLMs, AI agents, RPA + AI, document intelligence)
  • Light coding or scripting experience (Python, JavaScript, APIs)
  • Experience leading teams or cross-functional initiatives
  • Background in process improvement (Lean, Six Sigma, BPM​)


Tools You May Work With:

Zapier, Make, n8n, Airtable, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, OpenAI / LLM APIs, RPA tools, internal APIs, BI tools​.  


Why This Role Is a Career Accelerator:

  • High visibility with executive leadership
  • Ownership of company-wide automation and AI initiatives
  • Opportunity to define standards and long-term strategy
  • Clear progression path to Director of Automation / Director of AI
  • Real impact on how the business scales and operates​

title: Founding Engineer
description:
About Able

Able is the AI front office for Wholesale Plumbing, HVAC, and Electrical Suppliers. We're automating the soul-crushing manual work that buries inside sales teams - starting with fixture quoting.


The Wholesale Supply market is a $350B+ market running on spreadsheets and tribal knowledge. We're building the infrastructure to change that.


About the Role

Founding Engineer, with a focus on shipping Agents. You'll spec features, debug weird edge cases, scale infrastructure and help us figure out what to build next based on what customers actually need.

We're not looking for someone who needs a roadmap handed to them. We're looking for somebody who wants to help build the roadmap. If you see a problem, you fix it. If you don't know something, you learn it.


What we're looking for

  • 3 to 5 years of Software Engineering experience
  • Backend depth — you're comfortable owning a Python/FastAPI service end-to-end, from async request handling to data modeling to production debugging
  • Agent & LLM Fluent - you understand how agentic systems work and the failure modes that arise
  • Cloud comfortable - GCP, Firestore, Pub/Sub, Vercel, & Docker. You don't need to be an infra specialist but you shouldn't be scared of it
  • Document intelligence - comfortable working with document parsing & extraction pipelines (OCR, layout analysis, structured extraction, etc)


You're Likely a Fit If

  • You've designed, built, and shipped something with LLMs or Agents with real users
  • You're comfortable making decisions and backing up your logic
  • You default to shipping over planning. Iteration > Perfection
  • You've worked in an early-stage company before and are ready for the chaos
  • You're a tinkerer - also playing around with new technologies or projects


What You'll Do

  • Work with the Founding team to collect user feedback, design feature specs, implement updates, and deploy to production
  • Work across the stack: Python/FastAPI, Next.js/Typescript, Firebase, Docker, GCP, etc
  • Debug production issues and make them obsolete
  • Build and improve agent workflows using home grown frameworks
  • Help shape the product roadmap
  • Stay up to date on modern agent architectures/improvements and implement where
  • necessary

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:

We are looking for an experienced L2 Support Analyst to provide functional production support for enterprise Contract Management Software (CMS/CLM) platforms.   • Workflows, approvals, and business rule configurations

  • Support minor enhancements and functional configuration changes (non-code).
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues and coordinate with Level 3 technical teams when required.
  • Manage user access, role assignments, and permission-related issues.
  • Execute approved data corrections, metadata updates, and configuration fixes.
  • Support UAT and regression testing for fixes and minor platform updates.
  • Maintain support documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate closely with L1 support teams, business stakeholders, and L3 technical teams to ensure timely issue resolution.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience providing production support for Contract Management Software (CLM/CMS) platforms (e.g., Icertis, Coupa CLM, DocuSign CLM, SAP CLM, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with functional configurations, including:
  • Contract templates and clause libraries
  • Workflows, rules, and approvals
  • English (B2- Fluent)
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract types
  • Solid understanding of contract lifecycle management processes .
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications in complex or regulated environments.

title: Analista de Suporte de Sistemas SAP MM Pleno
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Prestar suporte Nível 2 aos utilizadores do módulo SAP MM (Materials Management), incluindo processos de compras (Procure to Pay), gestão de stocks, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), GNF (Gestão Não Financeira) para contratos de compra e serviços, e gestão de dados mestre de fornecedores e materiais (Cadastro BP).
  • Investigar e solucionar incidentes e problemas funcionais relacionados com os processos de compras, gestão de inventário, avaliação de materiais, e dados mestre.
  • Realizar análises de causa raiz para problemas nos processos de requisição de compra, cotação, pedido de compra, entrada de mercadorias (MIGO), entrada de faturas (MIRO), gestão de stocks e inventário físico.
  • Efetuar configurações e ajustes no módulo SAP MM para atender às necessidades do negócio e corrigir falhas, seguindo as melhores práticas e a governança de TI.
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais para melhorias ou correções que necessitem de desenvolvimento ABAP, colaborando com a equipa de Nível 3.
  • Participar ativamente nos testes funcionais e integrados de novas configurações, desenvolvimentos e melhorias no SAP MM.
  • Orientar e apoiar Key Users e analistas de Nível 1, partilhando conhecimento e auxiliando na resolução de dúvidas sobre os processos de MM.
  • Manter a documentação dos processos, configurações e soluções atualizada na
  • ferramenta Jira e na base de conhecimento.
  • Colaborar com as equipas de projeto em iniciativas de evolução do SAP S/4HANA e sistemas satélites relacionados com o módulo MM.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos SLAs para atendimento e solução de chamados.


Requisitos:

  • Profundo conhecimento dos processos de negócio de Compras (Procure-to-Pay), Gestão de Stocks e Recebimento Físico/Fiscal.
  • Conhecimento em configuração e parametrização do SAP MM (ex: estruturas organizacionais de compras, tipos de documento de compras, determinação de preços em compras, avaliação de materiais, gestão de lotes, números de série).
  • Conhecimento em processos de MRP e gestão de necessidades de materiais.
  • Familiaridade com a gestão de dados mestre de materiais e fornecedores (Business Partner).
  • Conhecimento da integração do SAP MM com outros módulos SAP (ex: FI, CO, SD, PP, QM).
  • Conhecimento em Jira para gestão de chamados.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Advogado
description:
O escritório De Bona & Piovesan Advogados procura Advogada(o) ou Bacharel(is) altamente capacitada(o)s, com perfil voltado para a área Bancária Agrícola e Urbana, com foco na defesa do Produtor Rural Endividado e na Área Bancária Urbana, também com enfoque na defesa de endividados e fraudes, interessada(o) em atuar na construção de peças processuais, petições iniciais, contestações, réplicas, recursos e pareceres jurídicos, desenvolvendo estratégias jurídicas eficazes para a defesa de produtores rurais em situações de endividamento, mantendo-se atualizada(o) sobre as legislações pertinentes e as melhores práticas do setor, e que aceite trabalhar na condição de FREELANCER e À DISTÂNCIA, respeitando as seguintes condições:


É INDISPENSÁVEL que a(o) candidata(o) seja atenta(o) aos detalhes, proativa(o), responsável, organizada(o) e ávida(o) por desafios intelectuais.


Experiência anterior e familiaridade ÍNTIMA na área são INDISPENSÁVEIS, já que haverá testes prévios que revelarão tal afinidade; sem esta, NÃO ADIANTA candidatar-se. Somará pontos em favor do FREELANCER ter vindo de família do campo ou, ao menos, possuir vivência real e conhecimento do dia a dia das pessoas do agro.


O desenvolvimento das atividades ofertadas e aceitas, se assim desejar o FREELANCER, será isento de subordinação, já que a(o) candidata(o) poderá escolher fazer ou não a tarefa encaminhada.


A onerosidade se dará exclusivamente de acordo com a produção, ou seja, haverá um valor pré-estabelecido para cada tarefa proposta. Por exemplo, a confecção de uma réplica será retribuída em R$ 120,00. Observação importante: grande parte das tarefas remetidas terá uma peça-base, a fim de que o trabalho não precise ser iniciado totalmente do zero.


O FREELANCER poderá receber um bônus por cada peça processual entregue, sendo R$ 20,00 para peças sem necessidade de ajustes; R$ 10,00 para peças com até 5 ajustes; e nenhum bônus para peças com mais de 5 ajustes.


Ajuste é QUALQUER alteração necessária apontada pelo Advogado revisor. O bônus, se houver, será pago juntamente com a peça.


Sem pessoalidade e sem habitualidade, ou seja, a(o) candidata(o) terá livre escolha para assumir a tarefa nos horários que bem entender, desde que seja atendido o prazo pré-estabelecido no momento do aceite.


Importante destacar ao FREELANCER que não é permitido entregar tarefas fora do prazo. A sanção para tal será o NÃO pagamento da peça.


Não são admitidas peças sem revisão via sistema do Word com leitura em voz alta. O FREELANCER deverá, obrigatoriamente, escutar a peça para buscar sua máxima perfeição.


Todas as peças serão novamente revisadas dentro do escritório e, ocorrendo erros inadmissíveis por duas vezes, deixar-se-á de remeter novas propostas de tarefas. Para fins de clareza, consideram-se erros inadmissíveis, por exemplo: erros de português; narração de fatos incondizentes com a situação real; citação incorreta do título de crédito pactuado ou omissão quando necessária; qualificação incorreta; endereçamento errado; notícias citadas erroneamente; dentre outras situações que comprometam minimamente a qualidade e a excelência dos préstimos do escritório aos clientes e revelem erros crassos da(o) Advogada(o).


A(o) Advogada(o) terá a oportunidade de somar conosco, interagir com a equipe e até tratar diretamente com os sócios do escritório, de forma virtual, obtendo uma visão abrangente, estratégica e integrada das atividades.

As(os) interessadas(os) deverão encaminhar, preferencialmente, currículo Lattes ou, caso não o possuam, currículo profissional, em ambas as situações para o e-mail: .

title: Engineering Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $8,500 - $10,000 USD


The Engineering Manager, Payments & Financial Infrastructure role is designed to own the technical systems responsible for money movement across their organization. At our partner, payments are not a support function. They are core product infrastructure. They advance funds to lab clients based on AI-driven claim valuation, reconcile against real insurance adjudication data, and manage complex settlement flows that must balance to the penny.


As transaction volume scales into hundreds of millions annually, the complexity of reliability, reconciliation, auditability, and compliance increases materially. This role exists to ensure they scale financial infrastructure with rigor, precision, and long-term architectural clarity. This is a player-coach leadership role, initially hands-on, evolving into team leadership and architectural stewardship of a dedicated payments engineering pod.


This role is accountable for:

  • Technical ownership of payment infrastructure and settlement systems
  • Reliability and correctness of all financial flows
  • Ledger and reconciliation architecture
  • Cross-team coordination for finance-critical systems
  • Building and leading a dedicated payments engineering pod


Key Responsibilities:


Payment Infrastructure Ownership

  • Own systems that disburse client advances, execute Treasury sweeps, process lockbox deposits, and generate settlement payments
  • Ensure all transactions reconcile precisely and remain fully auditable
  • Implement idempotency, monitoring, alerting, retry logic, and failure handling for payment-critical flows
  • Design workflows resilient to bank outages, ACH return codes, NSF events, and timing mismatches
  • Establish zero-error tolerance standards as volume scales


Ledger & Reconciliation Architecture

  • Design and evolve the internal ledger system tracking each receivable lifecycle from claim valuation to advance to adjudication to sweep to final settlement
  • Build reconciliation engines matching Payment Advances to ERA data
  • Automate weekly settlement calculations, including true-ups, clawbacks, and offsets
  • Ensure economic logic for Qualified vs. Non-Qualified claims is correctly implemented
  • Maintain strict auditability and financial traceability across systems


Cross-Team Collaboration & Platform Integration

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Data, Billing, and Clinical Platform teams
  • Ensure payment systems integrate cleanly with claim processing, ERA ingestion, and AI valuation systems
  • Partner with the Data team on financial reporting, reconciliation validation, and KPI consistency
  • Align with shared infrastructure standards including observability, deployment, security, and API governance
  • Actively participate in architecture discussions to prevent payment systems from becoming isolated silos


Payment infrastructure must operate as part of the broader platform, not adjacent to it.


Banking & Financial Partner Integration

  • Own integrations with banking partners and payment rails including ACH, EFT, and lockbox flows
  • Ensure client onboarding for Treasury Accounts and payment configuration is scalable and repeatable
  • Evaluate and integrate banking-as-a-service platforms and financial data providers
  • Maintain compliance with NACHA rules, treasury controls, and internal financial policies


Team Leadership & Engineering Standards

  • Hire and build a payments-focused engineering pod consisting of 2 to 3 engineers within 12 to 18 months
  • Define engineering standards for reliability, testing, deployment, and incident response
  • Establish operational playbooks for payment-critical systems
  • Partner closely with Payment Operations to ensure systems support real-world workflows
  • Balance hands-on contribution with leadership and long-term architectural planning


What This Role Is Not:

  • Not a purely operational finance role
  • Not a detached architecture-only leadership position
  • Not a payments API integration wrapper role


This is a systems-level ownership role where financial correctness, reliability, and architectural clarity are primary responsibilities.


What Success Looks Like:

  • All money movement is reliable, traceable, and auditable
  • Settlement logic is automated and predictable
  • Reconciliation discrepancies are rare and surfaced early
  • Banking integrations are standardized and repeatable
  • Payment-critical incidents decrease over time
  • Cross-team dependencies are clear and well-managed
  • A high-performing payments pod operates with strong engineering discipline


Ideal Background:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience
  • 3+ years building payment systems, financial infrastructure, or money movement platforms
  • Deep knowledge of ACH including NACHA rules, R-codes, batch construction, and prefunding
  • Experience designing ledger systems or reconciliation engines
  • Strong backend engineering experience including Python, Go, Java, or similar
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills
  • Experience operating payment-critical systems in production
  • Prior experience hiring or leading small engineering teams
  • Prior experience working at Nubank or in similar fintech companies


Strengths We Value:

  • Precision and rigor in financial system design
  • Systems thinking across multi-party money flows
  • Strong reliability mindset including observability, incident response, and recovery design
  • Clear, structured communication across engineering and finance stakeholders
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity while building durable architecture
  • High ownership and accountability


Why This Role Matters:

At our partner, money movement is core infrastructure, not an auxiliary capability.


Every advance, sweep, settlement, and reconciliation must be correct. As they scale into

hundreds of millions in annual volume, small architectural weaknesses compound into material financial risk.


This role ensures:

  • They scale financial infrastructure responsibly
  • They maintain trust with lab clients and banking partners
  • They prevent operational fragility as complexity grows
  • They build a durable foundation for future financial products


The Engineering Manager, Payments & Financial Infrastructure will help ensure that as they grow, their financial systems remain precise, resilient, and strategically aligned with the broader platform.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

Normas e segurança: Aplicar normas técnicas e boas práticas de segurança/estabilidade, assegurando que a solução seja segura, montável e adequada ao ambiente.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (.NET + Kubernetes + AI Accelerated Development)
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who thrives on using the latest and greatest backend technologies including .NET 10 and cloud-native patterns .


This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.


Our Backend Tech Stack

You’ll be working with a modern, cloud-native environment that includes:

  • .NET , .Net Core + EF (latest)
  • MySQL - primary transactional database
  • Amazon Redshift - analytics & reporting
  • Valkey (Redis) - high-performance caching
  • Kubernetes on AWS - service orchestration & scaling
  • Heavy use of AWS native services across compute, networking, messaging, and storage
  • Azure DevOps - CI/CD pipelines, deployments, automation
  • Microservices architecture following modern design patterns


What You Will Do

  • Build production-grade backend services using .NET 10 , .NET Core, and the latest EF features.
  • Design, build, and support microservices that are scalable, resilient, secure, and cloud-native.
  • Work across MySQL, Redshift, and Valkey (Redis) to support both transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Deploy and operate services in Kubernetes on AWS.
  • Own CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows in Azure DevOps .
  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code with a strong emphasis on unit testing and automated testing culture (TDD).
  • Collaborate with frontend, product, and AI teams to deliver features end-to-end.
  • Use AI-powered tools for code acceleration, debugging, test generation, refactoring, and documentation.
  • Contribute to shaping long-term system architecture with a path toward becoming a Solutions Architect / Principal Engineer .


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Strong backend experience with .NET / C# , and comfort with modern runtime features.
  • Experience with .NET Core , Entity Framework , and cloud-native backend development.
  • Solid understanding of microservices architecture , distributed system patterns, and clean coding principles.
  • Strong experience with unit testing and testable architecture.
  • If candidates cannot demonstrate real unit testing experience or passion, this role is not a good match.
  • Skilled in debugging, profiling, and optimizing backend systems.
  • Fluent English, comfortable with daily video-based communication.
  • Ability to work a full U.S. Pacific Time schedule.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Redshift or other analytical database systems.
  • Familiarity with AWS native services (SQS, SNS, Lambda, CloudWatch, IAM, etc.).
  • Experience with high-scale SaaS, data-heavy systems, or AI/ML integrations.
  • Experience with domain-driven design (DDD), event-driven patterns, or CQRS.


Who You Are

  • A self-motivated engineer with a passion for modern backend engineering.
  • Someone who enjoys working with the latest technologies , not legacy stacks.
  • A team player who cares about quality, testing, architecture, and long-term impact.
  • A builder who wants to grow into an architect and drive technical excellence.
  • A problem solver who takes ownership and thinks beyond task-level execution.
  • A strong believer in AI-accelerated development and continuous improvement.


Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building high-scale backend systems from the ground up. You’ll have the opportunity to define architectural foundations, build mission-critical services, and grow into a senior technical leader. Our stack gives you the chance to work with cutting-edge .NET technology, real cloud scale, and ambitious product challenges.

If you’re passionate about backend engineering, love modern .NET, and want to become a future architect, we’d love to talk.
