title: Desenvolvedor (a) Salesforce
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and implement scalable Salesforce solutions using Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Lightning Components.


  • Customize Salesforce objects, workflows, validation rules, and approval processes.


  • Develop Apex classes, triggers, Visualforce pages, Lightning Web Components (LWC).


  • Integrate Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs.


  • Perform data migration and ensure data integrity.


  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.


  • Conduct unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning.


  • Stay updated with Salesforce releases and best practices.


Required Skills:


  • Strong experience in Apex, Visualforce, LWC, SOQL, SOSL.


  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce configuration and customization.


  • Knowledge of Salesforce security model, sharing rules, and governor limits.


  • Experience with Salesforce integrations (API, middleware tools like MuleSoft).


  • Familiarity with Salesforce deployment tools (Change Sets, ANT, SFDX).


  • Good understanding of Agile methodology.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (.NET + Kubernetes + AI Accelerated Development)
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who thrives on using the latest and greatest backend technologies including .NET 10 and cloud-native patterns .


This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.


Our Backend Tech Stack

You’ll be working with a modern, cloud-native environment that includes:

  • .NET , .Net Core + EF (latest)
  • MySQL - primary transactional database
  • Amazon Redshift - analytics & reporting
  • Valkey (Redis) - high-performance caching
  • Kubernetes on AWS - service orchestration & scaling
  • Heavy use of AWS native services across compute, networking, messaging, and storage
  • Azure DevOps - CI/CD pipelines, deployments, automation
  • Microservices architecture following modern design patterns


What You Will Do

  • Build production-grade backend services using .NET 10 , .NET Core, and the latest EF features.
  • Design, build, and support microservices that are scalable, resilient, secure, and cloud-native.
  • Work across MySQL, Redshift, and Valkey (Redis) to support both transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Deploy and operate services in Kubernetes on AWS.
  • Own CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows in Azure DevOps .
  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code with a strong emphasis on unit testing and automated testing culture (TDD).
  • Collaborate with frontend, product, and AI teams to deliver features end-to-end.
  • Use AI-powered tools for code acceleration, debugging, test generation, refactoring, and documentation.
  • Contribute to shaping long-term system architecture with a path toward becoming a Solutions Architect / Principal Engineer .


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Strong backend experience with .NET / C# , and comfort with modern runtime features.
  • Experience with .NET Core , Entity Framework , and cloud-native backend development.
  • Solid understanding of microservices architecture , distributed system patterns, and clean coding principles.
  • Strong experience with unit testing and testable architecture.
  • If candidates cannot demonstrate real unit testing experience or passion, this role is not a good match.
  • Skilled in debugging, profiling, and optimizing backend systems.
  • Fluent English, comfortable with daily video-based communication.
  • Ability to work a full U.S. Pacific Time schedule.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Redshift or other analytical database systems.
  • Familiarity with AWS native services (SQS, SNS, Lambda, CloudWatch, IAM, etc.).
  • Experience with high-scale SaaS, data-heavy systems, or AI/ML integrations.
  • Experience with domain-driven design (DDD), event-driven patterns, or CQRS.


Who You Are

  • A self-motivated engineer with a passion for modern backend engineering.
  • Someone who enjoys working with the latest technologies , not legacy stacks.
  • A team player who cares about quality, testing, architecture, and long-term impact.
  • A builder who wants to grow into an architect and drive technical excellence.
  • A problem solver who takes ownership and thinks beyond task-level execution.
  • A strong believer in AI-accelerated development and continuous improvement.


Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building high-scale backend systems from the ground up. You’ll have the opportunity to define architectural foundations, build mission-critical services, and grow into a senior technical leader. Our stack gives you the chance to work with cutting-edge .NET technology, real cloud scale, and ambitious product challenges.

If you’re passionate about backend engineering, love modern .NET, and want to become a future architect, we’d love to talk.

title: AWS DevOps Engineer (Remote | PJ)
description:
100% Remote

EST USA Timezone

Contractor / PJ position

Duration: 6-12 months


Role Overview

We are seeking a AWS Cloud Automation Engineer to support the Database Engineering team. This is a hands-on, engineering-focused role centered on CI/CD automation , cloud database deployment, Terraform development , and acting as a technical escalation point.

This is not an operational/runbook role — the engineer must think architecturally, troubleshoot independently, and collaborate across multiple internal teams.

Core Responsibilities


Terraform Development

• Write, modify, and troubleshoot Terraform configurations

• Manage state, resolve drift, and support hybrid cloud deployments

• Contribute to new IaC standards and patterns

CI/CD Pipeline Engineering

• Build and troubleshoot Jenkins pipelines

• Support migration to GitHub and GitHub Actions

• Diagnose failures and implement durable fixes

Cloud Database Automation (AWS-focused)

• Automate database provisioning (Aurora, RDS, etc.)

• Work within evolving cloud automation frameworks

• Partner with architecture and delivery teams

Repository & Code Management

• Manage Bitbucket → GitHub migration

• Maintain version control best practices

• Contribute clear documentation and standards

Cross-Team Collaboration

• Work directly with:

o Database Engineering

o Architecture

o Delivery & Business Partners

• Serve as escalation for automation issues

• Share knowledge and support junior team members

Documentation & Communication

• Produce clean, detailed technical documentation

• Communicate clearly across all levels of the organization

Required Technical Skills

Must-Have

• Solid experience in DevOps/Cloud Engineering

• Strong hands-on experience with:

o Terraform (writing/developing, not just applying)

o Jenkins (build, modify, troubleshoot pipelines)

o AWS automation and deployments

• Troubleshooting CI/CD failures and infrastructure inconsistencies

• Git/Bitbucket repository management

Nice-to-Have

• GitHub & GitHub Actions

• GCP exposure

• Cloud database experience (Aurora, RDS, SQL Server, Postgres)

title: Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Machine Learning
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Machine Learning

Location: Brazil (remote)

Contract: PJ (long-term)

We’re looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to join our Inbound team and build highly scalable machine learning solutions that power item attribute detection (e.g., color, material, style) and merchandise authenticity verification.

If you’re passionate about solving real-world business problems using state-of-the-art Computer Vision and ML techniques — and enjoy taking ownership from research to production — we’d love to connect.


What You’ll Do

  • Develop and deploy Computer Vision and Machine Learning solutions to solve high-impact business challenges
  • Design, build, and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable production-grade code
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract insights and drive data-informed decisions
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies (CNNs, Transformers, GANs, etc.) to build robust models
  • Lead the technical direction of key components and systems
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Tech Leads to deliver deployable solutions
  • Mentor team members and help grow domain expertise
  • Contribute to technical leadership through patents and publications


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in Computer Vision and Applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s or PhD in CS, ML, Statistics, or related field (or 8+ years of industry experience)
  • 3+ years building, deploying, and managing ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Deep understanding of ML/CV techniques: CNNs, Transformers, GANs, optimizers, regularization
  • Strong experience with experiment design, A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, and feature engineering
  • Proficiency in Python and scientific libraries (NumPy, Pandas)
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn)
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with experiment automation tools (Ray Tune, Weights & Biases, Kubeflow)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, OR, or related field
  • Experience applying ML to real-world retail problems
  • Familiarity with MLOps pipelines and tools
  • Strong ownership mindset with a focus on measurable business impact

title: Analista administrativo financeiro
description:
Buscamos um profissional para atuar na sustentação operacional de uma consultoria de tecnologia. O foco desta posição é a execução precisa e autônoma das rotinas que conectam o Departamento Pessoal, a gestão de contratos e o suporte financeiro. É fundamental ter um perfil hands-on, alta capacidade de organização e familiaridade com o ecossistema SAP.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Operação de DP : Executar processos de admissão, desligamento, controle de jornadas e organização de documentos para a folha de pagamento.

Gestão Operacional de Contratos : Realizar o input, acompanhamento de vigência e organização de contratos de prestadores de serviço (PJ) e fornecedores.

Apoio Financeiro: Atuar no suporte operacional de Contas a Pagar e Receber, garantindo que as conciliações e fluxos de pagamentos sigam o cronograma.

Rotinas SAP: Realizar toda a inserção de dados, consultas e extração de relatórios nos módulos administrativos do SAP.

Compras e Suprimentos : Operacionalizar a compra de materiais de escritório, equipamentos e contratação de serviços gerais de manutenção.

Requisitos e Qualificações

Experiência Plena : vivência anterior em funções administrativas e financeiras operacionais.

Domínio de SAP: Experiência prática no sistema.

Conhecimento em DP: Familiaridade com as rotinas de departamento pessoal e documentação trabalhista/previdenciária.

Habilidade com Contratos: Noção técnica para manusear e organizar minutas e termos aditivos.

Soft Skills Imprescindíveis: * Atenção aos detalhes: Foco total na conferência de valores e prazos.

Flexibilidade: Capacidade de priorizar tarefas em um ambiente dinâmico de tecnologia.

Organização: Manter fluxos de documentos e processos sistêmicos impecáveis.

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 51671


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Analista de Administração Pessoal e Benefícios Junior
description:
Responsável por assegurar a correta administração dos processos de ponto, benefícios e apoio aos cálculos de folha de pagamento, garantindo conformidade legal, acuracidade das informações e cumprimento de prazos. Atuará no controle e conferência de dados trabalhistas, apoiando a consistência dos lançamentos, mitigação de riscos e melhoria contínua dos processos de administração de pessoal.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Realizar a gestão e conferência do controle de ponto eletrônico, tratando inconsistências, banco de horas, horas extras, afastamentos e escalas.
  • Garantir cumprimento de prazos legais e obrigações acessórias relacionadas à compra, cadastro e disponibilização dos benefícios.
  • Atuar na interface com fornecedores de folha e benefícios, assegurando qualidade e precisão das informações.
  • Apoiar o processamento da folha de pagamento, realizando conferências prévias, validação de eventos e suporte aos cálculos trabalhistas.
  • Administrar benefícios (vale-transporte, vale-refeição/alimentação, plano de saúde, seguro, entre outros), incluindo movimentações, inclusões, exclusões e conferências de faturas.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e controles internos relacionados aos benefícios.
  • Apoiar o controle e cálculo de férias, 13º salário, admissões, desligamentos e encargos sociais.


Formação e Conhecimentos

  • Nível superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Gestão de RH ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em administração de pessoal e rotinas de folha de pagamento.
  • Vivência com controle de ponto eletrônico e gestão de benefícios.
  • Conhecimento de legislação trabalhista e encargos sociais.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado.
  • Desejável experiência com sistemas de folha e e-Social.

title: Analista de Controladoria SR
description:
Assessoramos importante empresa na contratação de um Analista de Controladoria Sr.

Resumo da Posição:

O analista de controladoria sênior é o profissional responsável pela análise do desempenho financeiro, elaboração de relatórios gerenciais da área, elaborar o planejamento do budget e forecast, monitorar indicadores da área, apoiar a diretoria em análises e tomada de decisões que envolvam impactos financeiros, sempre visando os objetivos da empresa. É responsável por garantir a saúde financeira dos processos e projetos da empresa, identificar oportunidades de melhorias e otimizar procedimentos e controles internos.

Principais responsabilidades:

Fechamento contábil:

  • Revisão e validação de todos os lançamentos contábeis da empresa;
  • Interface com contabilidade e áreas operacionais para esclarecimento de variações ou inconsistências;
  • Apurar resultados gerenciais, analisar variações, gerar relatórios e apoiar decisões.

Relatórios:

  • Consolidar os dados financeiros e operacionais, incluindo elaboração do Balanço Patrimonial e DRE (realizado vs. orçado vs. forecast);
  • Realizar relatórios gerenciais, orçamentários, indicadores financeiros gerais e relatórios de fechamento;
  • Estudo de variações, identificação de causas, geração de insights financeiros;
  • Envio de relatórios mensais à matriz.

Planejamento financeiro:

  • Definição de dados relevantes;
  • Elaboração, revisão e suporte na construção de todo planejamento financeiro de curto, médio e longo prazo;
  • Organização de dados financeiros de áreas diferentes;
  • Análise de dados de acordo com modelos e cenários diferentes;
  • Alinhamento com o planejamento estratégico da empresa;
  • Atualização de previsões;
  • Apresentação para a diretoria e elaboração de planos de ação.

Gestão orçamentária:

  • Gestão do planejamento e orçamento;
  • Monitorar execução do planejamento, apontando desvios e suportando na construção dos devidos planos de ações;
  • Identificar e analisar variações real x orçado.

Apoio à liderança:

  • Elaboração de relatórios financeiros relevantes para cada área;
  • Esclarecimento de dúvidas da diretoria e fornecimento de insumos para a tomada de decisões.


Requisitos


  • Formação em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência consolidada em controladoria e planejamento financeiro.
  • Domínio de Excel avançado; rotinas em ERP;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação será um diferencial.
  • Capacidade analítica, visão estratégica e atenção a detalhes.
  • Inglês avançado.

title: Accounting Manager - US GAAP
description:
Lead US Accounting. Operate at a Global Standard.

  • MAVI is building a high-performance global finance network — embedding senior accounting leaders across LATAM directly into US leadership teams.
  • We are hiring experienced US Accounting Managers who are ready to operate as trusted finance partners to US CFOs and Controllers — owning close cycles, financial reporting, and operational excellence.


The Opportunity

You will serve as a direct extension of a US finance team, leading month-end close and overseeing reporting accuracy for high-growth and mid-market US companies.

This role is designed for senior professionals who want:

  • Direct collaboration with US leadership
  • High ownership and accountability
  • Exposure to global accounting standards
  • Long-term strategic partnership


What You Will Own

  • Lead and manage full month-end close under US GAAP
  • Oversee journal entries, reconciliations, and reporting packages
  • Ensure financial statements are accurate and timely
  • Supervise and guide accounting team members
  • Interface directly with US Controllers and CFOs
  • Strengthen reporting frameworks and internal controls
  • Drive process improvements and operational efficiency


What We’re Looking For

  • 6–8+ years of US GAAP accounting experience
  • Demonstrated leadership of close cycles
  • Experience managing or mentoring accounting teams
  • Strong financial reporting and GL expertise
  • Experience working directly with US stakeholders
  • ERP exposure (NetSuite preferred)
  • Strong professional English communication


Why Join MAVI

  • Operate at the same standard as US-based finance teams
  • Gain direct visibility with US leadership
  • Work on sophisticated, scaling businesses
  • Be part of a curated global network of senior accounting professionals


This Role Is Ideal For

  • Senior accounting leaders in LATAM who want more than transactional accounting — and are ready to operate as strategic finance partners within US organizations.

title: Head Comercial
description:
Vaga: Head Comercial 

Florianópolis | Presencial

Mercado Imobiliário de Alto Padrão


Buscamos um(a) Head Comercial para liderar área de vendas com visão estratégica, execução impecável e mentalidade de escala:

Experiência sólida no mercado imobiliário (incorporação ou alto padrão);

Histórico comprovado de metas atingidas ou superadas;

title: AI Video Editor
description:
Hiring: AI Video Editor / Performance Videographer

Company: Rain Media

Reports to: Creative Director

Status: Full-time Contractor (Global)

Location: Argentina and Brazil, preferred


Position Overview

Are You a Performance-Driven Video Editor Who Knows How to Turn Creative Into Conversions? If you think in hooks, pacing, and paid social performance, and you’re already leveraging AI video tools to produce faster, smarter creative, this role is for you.

At Organics Ocean, we’re looking for an AI-native Video Editor / Performance Videographer who will help scale high-volume direct response creative. This role exists to solve a key business need: increasing creative output, improving execution speed, and reducing revision cycles while elevating the quality of edits through advanced AI workflows.

This is a production-first role focused primarily on editing, post-production, and AI-enhanced creative, not traditional filming.

You will work closely with Creative, Growth, and Marketing partners to deliver performance-focused assets that directly impact campaign velocity.


Who we are: Organics Ocean

We are a premium direct-to-consumer supplement brand helping people live healthier lives through science-backed, clean, and effective products.

We’re not a company where things stay the same. We test, we optimize, we innovate—and we want someone who thrives in that kind of high-accountability, fast-paced environment.


Why join our team?


High-growth eCommerce brand: Driven by innovation and fast execution, Organics Ocean has seen 350% year over year growth.


Ownership & Accountability: We trust our team members to take full ownership of their responsibilities. You are empowered to lead, execute, and improve without micromanagement. We value individuals who take initiative, hold themselves accountable, and drive meaningful results.


A team of high performers: We push boundaries, move fast, and get things done. The company is in a hockey stick growth phase. This is not a good fit for those who don’t want to grow.


Responsibilities

Direct Response Video Editing

  • Produce high-quality paid social performance creatives
  • Execute UGC edits, AI creative, AI UGC, mini-VSL, and VSL formats
  • Optimize pacing, hooks, and CTAs for conversion
  • Deliver high output with minimal revision cycles

AI Video Workflow Integration

  • Use AI tools to accelerate production and improve quality
  • Create both AI-forward and AI-assisted realistic creatives
  • Continuously test new AI workflows to improve performance

Creative Collaboration

  • Partner with Creative Strategy to execute briefs
  • Attend creative meetings to reduce revision loops
  • Align closely with Creative leadership on feedback

Production & Workflow Support

  • Act as a point of contact between Creative Lead and external editors
  • Help disseminate process updates and feedback to contractors
  • Support operational efficiency and creative throughput

Filming (Secondary Responsibility)

  • Occasional product shots or B-roll when needed


What success looks like


First 90 Days

  • Fully ramp into Rain Media’s performance creative workflow and AI editing stack
  • Deliver consistent weekly output aligned to creative briefs and paid social requirements
  • Demonstrate proficiency using required AI tools within real production workflows
  • Reduce revision cycles by actively participating in creative meetings and feedback loops
  • Establish clear collaboration rhythms with Creative leadership and external editors
  • Begin contributing process improvements that increase speed and execution quality

In 12 months:

  • Consistently deliver 15–20 high-performing creatives per week with strong execution speed
  • Become a key leverage point for creative production, supporting communication with external editors and improving workflow efficiency
  • Elevate overall creative quality through advanced AI integration and experimentation
  • Maintain a standard of ≤1 revision cycle between strategy and editing whenever possible
  • Help scale creative volume without sacrificing performance or brand quality
  • Contribute to evolving Rain Media’s AI-first creative production framework


Requirements

Requirements (Expected Proficiencies to Excel in This Role)

  • Ability to communicate (speak/write) fluent English
  • 2 + yrs proven experience editing direct response performance creatives for paid social platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.)
  • Must have AI video experience and samples to showcase your work
  • Strong understanding of conversion-focused editing, including hooks, pacing, storytelling, and call-to-action structure
  • Demonstrated ability to produce high-volume creative output in a fast-paced, test-and-learn environment
  • Hands-on experience using AI video generation and enhancement tools within production workflows
  • Proficiency with core editing platforms such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of creative design tools such as Canva, Photoshop, or Figma
  • Experience collaborating closely with creative strategists, growth teams, or performance marketing teams
  • Ability to interpret creative briefs and execute with minimal revision cycles
  • Strong communication skills and comfort participating in real-time feedback sessions
  • Ability to manage multiple creative experiments simultaneously while maintaining speed and quality

AI & Technical Proficiency (Required)

  • Experience working with tools such as Higgsfield, Google V3/Gemini workflows , or similar AI-driven platforms
  • Understanding of AI-assisted editing techniques, including both overt AI creative and realistic AI integrations

Nice-to-Have Proficiencies

  • Experience with advanced AI platforms such as Sora, Kling , or emerging generative video tools
  • Familiarity with open-source AI workflows or technical experimentation across AI ecosystems
  • Background supporting or coordinating external video editors or creative contractors

Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to work within US time zones (Eastern preferred)
  • Access to a work computer, a reliable internet connection and a distraction-free workspace
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response and AI-enhanced video work


Offer Details

Compensation: Contractor compensation will be aligned to regional market benchmarks based on the candidate’s country of residence and expressed as monthly salary ranges.


About Organics Ocean

To learn the founder’s story and more about Organics Ocean, visit the website.

The company is a place for innovation. Team roles and responsibilities are clear, and the passion for being a part of something bigger than oneself is shared by everyone. The environment is casual, but the work is serious. Riding this wave of growth only works with A-Players on the team, and that is what everyone is: an A-Player.


Cultural Pillars:

  • Accountability : Take full ownership of your responsibilities and their outcomes. You commit to seeing tasks through, accepting both successes and failures as your own, and continuously learning and improving along the way.
  • Operational Excellence: We believe a strong Foundation is a scalable business. In e-commerce, every action becomes a building block and small cracks compound quickly as we grow. We prioritize building reliable processes, systems, and standards that hold up under scale. We fix breakdowns early, design for consistency, and execute with discipline so growth doesn't introduce chaos.
  • Clarity & Trust: Clarity builds trust, and it goes both ways. Leaders are responsible for setting clear expectations, priorities, and context. Team members are responsible for asking questions, raising their hands, and seeking clarity when something is unclear. When clarity is actively given an actively sought, trust grows, decisions improve, and the teams move faster together.
  • Efficient Leverage: Efficient leverage means doing the right work, not more work. We challenge the status quo, explore better ways of working, and speak up when we see opportunities to improve. We value fresh thinking, but apply it with intention, building systems, making decisions, and creating leverage that drives meaningful impact. Through innovation paired with discipline, we pull the right levers to move the business forward and scale sustainably.
  • Move Fast and Persevere: We push forward with speed and determination, even when things get tough. In the fast-paced world of e-commerce and startups, challenges are inevitable. Success comes from acting quickly, adapting, and staying resilient when obstacles arise. We don’t slow down when things get hard—we press through and keep moving forward.

title: Email Graphic Designer

  • Experience designing for SMS, push notifications, or other retention marketing channels
  • Understanding of email deliverability factors and how design choices impact inbox placement


Compensation And Benefits

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Head of Digital Media
description:
About VEL


Civilization is shifting.

AI is no longer confined to the browser. Work is decentralizing. Cities are restructuring. Corporate real estate is contracting.

VEL is building Physical AI infrastructure — intelligent, distributed environments embedded into airports, commercial buildings, and urban nodes.

VEGA is what people experience. IRIS is the intelligence layer that governs it.

We are not building consumer apps.

We are building embodied AI systems operating in real-world environments.

Perception matters. Narrative matters. Authority matters.

This role exists to shape how the world understands what we are building.

The Role

The Head of Digital Media & Social Strategy owns VEL’s external narrative architecture across digital platforms — with primary emphasis on executive-level social presence.

This is not a community manager role.

This is not a paid ads role.

This is not influencer marketing.

This is strategic storytelling at infrastructure scale.

You will shape how investors, real estate partners, technologists, and operators perceive VEL.

Core Responsibilities

● Architect and manage CEO digital presence (LinkedIn, X primarily)

● Translate complex Physical AI concepts into compelling, high-authority content

● Build structured content cadence aligned with fundraise and deployment milestones

● Draft executive-level thought leadership

● Develop long-form and short-form narrative

● Oversee visual language consistency across platforms

● Coordinate announcements (product, partnerships, capital)

● Track audience quality, not vanity metrics

● Align digital positioning with capital strategy

This role requires editorial precision, strategic thinking, and executive-level maturity.

Mandatory Qualifications (Non-Negotiable)

You must have:

● 5+ years leading digital strategy or executive communications

● Direct experience managing a C-level executive’s social presence

● Demonstrated experience writing long-form thought leadership

● Experience in venture-backed, deep-tech, B2B, or infrastructure environments

● Strong understanding of LinkedIn-native growth mechanics

● Fluent professional English (written and spoken)

● Comfort working closely with a founder

You Are Likely Coming From

● A venture-backed startup

● A B2B technology company

● A deep-tech or AI company

● A founder-brand building role

● An executive communications leadership position


You understand that:

● Authority compounds over time

● Digital presence influences capital perception

● Language shapes market category

● Precision matters more than volume

● Infrastructure companies must sound different than consumer brands

You are strategic.

You are literate.

You think long-term.

Who Should Not Apply

● Influencer marketers

● Lifestyle brand managers

● Pure paid performance marketers

● Meme-driven content creators

● Candidates without executive-level writing experience


Travel Requirement

Up to 45-60 days per year may be required for:

● Deployment launches

● Investor events

● Manufacturing visits

● Strategic announcements

Candidates must be comfortable with periodic international travel.

Compensation

$40,000 – $60,000 USD + performance-based equity

Compensation reflects executive narrative responsibility and long-term alignment.

Reporting Line

Reports directly to the CEO.

This role has strategic influence across fundraise, product positioning, and external communications.

Role Type

Full-time, long-term strategic hire.

We are building infrastructure for the next era of work.

Narrative discipline is part of that build.

title: Customer Support Specialist (German Desk)
description:
Genesis is a full-service international IT company. More than 1,500 people in five countries create products for more than 200 million unique monthly users. We are one of the largest partners of Facebook, Google, Snapchat, and Apple in Eastern Europe. Our ecosystem consists of more than 15 companies and an investment fund.


EverHelp is a company in the Genesis ecosystem. We’re a team of professionals, that’s developing outsourcing support services for plenty of products all over the world at a dynamic tempo. The project launched in 2021, and we've experienced a yearly growth rate of +82%. Since February 2022, we've managed to preserve all our workplaces and, most importantly, we continue to strengthen our team while maintaining an employee satisfaction rate of over 90%.


The vacancy is open due to the start of cooperation with a new client in the FoodTech domain.

To support the client’s customers across multiple channels and ensure consistently high service quality, we are expanding the support team and looking for a Customer Support Representative with strong English and German communication skills.


Role Mission

To provide fast, accurate, and customer-oriented support for the client’s users by handling requests via tickets and chat, ensuring high CSAT, meeting SLA targets, and maintaining consistent service quality in daily operations.


Responsibilities:

  • Handle customer inquiries via tickets and chat in German and English.
  • Provide clear, structured, and empathetic responses while following internal processes and guidelines.
  • Maintain a high service quality level and consistently meet SLA requirements (FRT and Time to Close).
  • Resolve typical customer issues independently and escalate more complex cases when needed.
  • Work with multiple support tools and internal documentation to ensure correct case handling.
  • Contribute to maintaining and improving internal documentation and support workflows.
  • Ensure accurate communication and attention to detail in customer-facing messages.


Working schedule:

  • Monday–Friday
  • 12:00 AM – 8:00 AM CET
  • Break included


About You:

  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Support (chat/tickets).
  • German and English at C1/C2 level (written and spoken).
  • Strong written communication skills: clear structure, literacy, and attention to detail.
  • Fast typing and confidence working in a high-load environment.
  • Basic Excel / Google Sheets skills.
  • Strong information search skills and ability to work with documentation.
  • Ability to stay calm under pressure and handle urgent requests professionally.
  • High responsibility and reliability (SLA-driven role).
  • Empathy and strong customer focus, especially in complaint handling.


Work with EverHelp is about:

  • Opportunity to join a new client project from the early stage and contribute to building stable support operations.
  • Work in a dynamic environment with international customers and daily real-life problem solving.
  • Professional growth in customer communication, conflict resolution, and working with CRM/support tools.
  • Clear performance expectations and measurable KPIs (CSAT, FRT, Time to Close).
  • Fully remote work.
  • 20 days of paid vacation.
  • 10 paid sick leave days (with confirmation).
  • Well-being bonus
  • Paid training.
  • Stable collaboration format and transparent processes.

title: Data Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position and is a PJ contract.


Required Skills & Experience


- 5+ years of experience with Power BI development and engineering (DAX and semantic model development and deployment)

- Strong hands on coding ability in PySpark and Python

- Professional working experience with Databricks and Spark platforms

- Experience working in Microsoft Fabric

- Fair knowledge on the use of Azure Dev Ops (ADO) to manage repository and versions

- Strong communication skills and experience engaging directly with business stakeholders and technical teams


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

- Experience working for a global company/ with a global team


Job Description


A global biopharmaceutical company is seeking strong Data Engineers to join their team to support a portfolio of ongoing clinical operations projects. These individuals will work on a team of Engineers of all levels and will partner with technical and functional partners to meet the project needs. The ideal candidates should and in-depth expertise with Power BI (including DAX and Semantic Model Development), strong PySpark & Python coding experience, and experience with Databricks. 100% remote

English and Portuguese are required

Candidates from LATAM

This role is the technical leader responsible for designing, building, and maintaining ServiceNow’s unified customer engagement platform (NOW Engage), serving Expert Services and Partner consultants globally.


The Technical Architect translates business requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions, ensures platform integrity and performance, and provides hands‑on technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.

  • Design scalable ServiceNow solutions aligned with best practices.
  • Lead architecture for multi‑tenant NOW Engage, ensuring security, data isolation, and performance.

  • Guide scrum teams, oversee code reviews, and enforce technical standards.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts, executives, and cross‑functional teams to align business and technical goals.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise standards, security, and regulatory requirements (GDPR, CCPA).

  • 6–10+ years of ServiceNow experience (development, administration, architecture).
  • Deep knowledge of ServiceNow products (CSM, SPM, ITSM, ITOM).
  • Expertise in custom app development, advanced data models, workflows, and API integrations.
  • Strong coding skills (JavaScript, REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, UI Builder).
  • Experience with multi‑tenant architecture, scalability, and performance optimization.
  • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.


Preferred

  • ServiceNow CTA, CIS, or CAD certifications.
  • Experience with AI/GenAI integrations and Agile/SAFe methodologies.
  • Leadership of scrum teams and collaboration with external vendors.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps.


Key Attributes

  • Architectural thinking and problem‑solving.
  • Strong technical leadership and quality focus.
  • Executive presence with excellent communication skills.
  • Collaborative and adaptable in dynamic environments.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% annually.

title: Executive Assistant (Technical)
description:
Executive Assistant (Technical)

Salary: $1250 - $1500 / month

Working Hours: Central Time

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location : Remote


About the Role

We’re hiring an Executive Assistant to support the founder across both traditional EA responsibilities and technical project coordination.


You’ll help keep day-to-day operations organized, while also translating ideas and conversations into clear work streams that developers can execute against.


We’re looking for someone product-minded — someone who thinks about how things should work, asks good questions, and cares about quality. If you’re highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with software tools and technical teams, this role is a strong fit.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support the founder with traditional executive assistant tasks (scheduling, organization, follow-ups, documentation, coordination)
  • Watch client calls or internal discussions and turn them into clear work streams and task lists
  • Explain to developers exactly what needs to be built and why
  • Test features and applications after development and document issues or improvements
  • Perform light setup and cleanup in tools like Airtable, Notion, and Excel / Google Sheets


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • +2 years of experience as an Executive Assistant
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Strong organization and attention to detail
  • Comfortable using tools like Excel / Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, and task management tools
  • Able to communicate clearly with both non-technical and technical teammates


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience supporting US-based founders or agencies
  • Prior exposure to QA / testing or software-related projects


Why Join Us?

  • Work directly with the founder
  • Get hands-on experience coordinating real software and automation projects
  • Build transferable skills in technical project coordination and operations

title: Product Designer
description:
SigmaMD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.


Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:


  • Contribute to high-level product thinking while also developing interaction flows, mockups, and prototypes. 
  • Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback.
  • Advocate for the needs and preferences of both doctors and patients by conducting user research and gathering feedback from both groups, and incorporating their insights into the design process to ensure the product meets the needs of all stakeholders.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.


This person should share our core values of teamwork, empathy, and innovation. Ideally, they have the following:


  • Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams.
  • Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy.
  • Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team.
  • Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries.
  • Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs)..
  • Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team.
  • Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role).
  • Able to provide samples of work that show creative solutions to complex products, strong visual design, and information architecture.
  • A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design.
  • Experience with Figma.
  • Understand how modern technologies are used with design.
  • Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked.
  • Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas.
  • Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements.
  • Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work.
  • Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem.
  • Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity
  • Facilitate both design-focused and cross-functional sessions with ease, relying on your knowledge of facilitation tools and techniques


Desired Skills

  • Have an understanding of front end technologies such as HTML and CSS.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Prior experience in a design related role at a startup.
  • Experience with digital health or relatable areas.
  • Experience working with mobile apps.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Company Description

Empregos.com.br is one of Brazil's premier job and career platforms, connecting professionals with employment opportunities and providing career guidance and training. With over 180,000 job offers from 80,000 companies and a database of more than 1 million resumes, the platform serves as a key resource for job seekers and employers. The service is free for companies to post job openings or search for candidates, aiding in creating meaningful connections in the job market. Empregos.com.br is committed to bridging the gap between talent and opportunity in Brazil.


Role Description

We are looking for a Mid-Level or Senior Frontend Developer to work directly on building and evolving our digital products.


What you will do on a daily basis:

Develop and enhance frontend applications using Vue.js and Nuxt.js

Work with SSR (Server-Side Rendering), technical SEO, and web performance

Consume and integrate REST APIs

Continuously improve Core Web Vitals and search engine indexation

Participate in technical decisions and frontend architecture evolution

Work in agile cycles, with frequent deliveries and constant feedback

Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Backend teams to deliver high-impact solutions


What we expect from you:

Solid experience with Vue.js and/or Nuxt.js

SEO is not a plus — it’s mandatory (rendering, indexing, performance)

Experience consuming Web APIs

Experience with CI/CD pipelines

Experience with Docker containers

Strong knowledge of Git

Ability to translate design into pixel-perfect, high-performance interfaces

Agile mindset: prioritization, short delivery cycles, and continuous improvement


Nice to have:


Experience working on high-traffic projects

Strong knowledge of frontend performance optimization

Previous experience with SEO-driven products


What we offer:


100% remote work

Technical autonomy and space for decision-making

A product with real impact and scale

A collaborative environment where we learn and grow together

Contractor agreement (PJ)


If you enjoy solving real problems, working at scale, optimizing SEO and performance, and growing alongside a living product, this opportunity is for you!

title: England Packaging Salesperson, Remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.

Role Description

We are seeking an experienced English Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into English markets, with a strong understanding of English business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.

Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.

Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be responsible for:

- Developing and maintaining relationships with English cosmetic and personal care brands

- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within England's cosmetic packaging market

- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements

- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting

- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction

- Meeting and exceeding sales targets

- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in English cosmetic packaging markets

Qualifications

- Proven track record of successful B2B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries

- Extensive experience working with English cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers

- Strong knowledge of English cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements

- Fluent in English

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

- Ability to travel to England as needed (20-30% of the time)

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field

- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools

- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Product Owner
description:
Como Product Owner, você será responsável por conduzir processos de descoberta, ideação e validação  das funcionalidades do produto, transformando necessidades em soluções claras e priorizadas. Atuará diretamente com o time de desenvolvimento, garantindo a evolução contínua do produto, alinhamento com stakeholders e entrega de valor aos usuários. 

RESPONSABILIDADES: 


  • Entendimento dos requisitos/necessidades das áreas de negócio;

  • Atuar junto com o líder técnico, identificando possíveis atrasos nas entregas e definindo mudanças de prioridades; 
  • Manter-se em constante atualização com as melhores práticas do mercado, trazendo sugestões e novas soluções.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?


O que você vai fazer


O Tech Lead será responsável por liderar tecnicamente o time de desenvolvimento que atua em sistemas de processamento de produtos core (crédito, débito, vouchers). Este profissional deverá atuar como um facilitador, promovendo o alinhamento técnico entre os membros da equipe e assegurando que as soluções atendam aos padrões de qualidade, alta performance e tolerância a falhas. title: Clinical Trial Associate II
description:
Clinical Trial Associate II


Resumo da Posição

O Clinical Trial Associate II desempenha um papel fundamental de suporte no planejamento, execução e encerramento de estudos clínicos nacionais e internacionais, com crescente autonomia e independência operacional. Com base em experiências prévias em operações de estudos clínicos, espera-se que o CTA II gerencie proativamente a documentação e os processos principais, identifique e resolva desafios operacionais, e atue como um ponto de coordenação confiável entre as equipes de estudo, fornecedores e centros de pesquisa. Este cargo também contribui para melhorias de processos e apoia a equipe na preparação para auditorias e inspeções.


Principais Responsabilidades:

• Fornecer suporte operacional para a execução bem-sucedida dos estudos clínicos, do desenvolvimento do protocolo até o encerramento do estudo, em conformidade com as Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e normas regulatórias internacionais.

• Gerenciar de forma independente os controles dos estudos clínicos, incluindo acompanhamento de documentos regulatórios, progresso de start-up, métricas de recrutamento, registros de faturas/pagamentos e desempenho de fornecedores, assegurando precisão, consistência e atualizações em tempo hábil.

• Coordenar reuniões de estudos clínicos (internas e externas), incluindo preparação de agendas, logística dos encontros e atas detalhadas com ações de acompanhamento.

• Apoiar a supervisão de fornecedores e CROs, acompanhando entregas, identificando lacunas ou riscos e comunicando-os preventivamente aos Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs).

• Auxiliar na preparação e submissão de documentos para Comitês de Ética/Comissões de Ética (IRB/EC) e para órgãos regulatórios, com papel ampliado na gestão de prazos e controle de qualidade.

• Realizar revisões contínuas do Trial Master File (TMF) e reconciliações; liderar atividades de controle de qualidade de documentos com supervisão mínima e contribuir ativamente para o planejamento de prontidão para inspeções.

• Coordenar e acompanhar a logística de equipamentos e suprimentos dos estudos clínicos junto a fornecedores e centros.

• Colaborar com CTMs e demais áreas para promover melhorias contínuas de processos e contribuir para atualizações de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (SOP) e instruções de trabalho.

• Assumir responsabilidade por projetos especiais e iniciativas transversais que exijam iniciativa, pensamento analítico e discernimento para resolver problemas.


Qualificações

• Graduação preferencialmente nas áreas de Ciências Biológicas ou Saúde.

• Inglês Fluente

• Conhecimento prático demonstrado das diretrizes ICH-GCP e normas regulatórias aplicáveis; experiência prévia no suporte a TMF, CTMS e atividades de controle de qualidade documental é obrigatória.

• Fortes habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação escrita; confortável em interagir com áreas como Garantia da Qualidade, Gerenciamento de Dados, Bioestatística, Segurança e Suprimentos Clínicos.

• Capacidade de antecipar as necessidades da equipe, tomar iniciativa e propor soluções em um ambiente dinâmico.

• Confortável em lidar com dados sensíveis, exercendo discrição adequada.


Contratação no regime PJ, posição remota com disponibilidade para viagens internacionais conforme necessidade.

  • Develop new and existing markets and client base, promote our trading solutions

  • Strong understanding of FX, CFDs, trading platforms (e.g., MT4/MT5), and brokerage operations
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Experience working with CRM systems and managing sales pipelines
  • Existing network of traders, IBs, or affiliates is a strong advantage
  • Ability to analyze market trends and identify revenue opportunities
  • Target-driven mindset with experience working toward KPIs and revenue goals
  • Willingness to travel for partner meetings, expos, and industry events


What We Offer


  • Competitive base salary & performance-based incentives and bonuses
  • Opportunity to influence regional partnership and client acquisition strategies
  • Career progression within a well-established Forex Brokerage environment
  • Exposure to global financial markets and advanced trading technologies
  • Flexible working arrangement


If you’re a results-driven business development professional with industry experience and a passion for building strong client and partner relationships, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today.

title: Finance Operations Manager
description:
Job Title: Finance & Operations Manager (Part-Time)

About the Company:

Our client is a fast-growing B2B software company providing enterprises, especially financial institutions, with a platform to accelerate innovation. The platform simplifies the discovery, validation, and scaling of vendors, tools, and data solutions, reducing the time, risk, and cost associated with adopting fintech solutions.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking a Finance & Operations Manager to work closely with the CFO and take ownership of day-to-day finance and selected operational responsibilities. This is a hands-on, number-two role within the finance function, ideal for someone who enjoys both detailed execution and contributing to strategic initiatives in a scaling environment. This position is part-time and fully remote.

Responsibilities:

• Lead and own the month-end close and bookkeeping processes.

• Consolidate multiple entities into a single, accurate set of accounts (essential requirement).

• Manage day-to-day accounts payable and receivable processes.

• Support the CFO with financial planning, KPI tracking, and preparation of investor materials.

• Maintain and update financial forecasts and cash flow models.

• Support international expansion initiatives from a finance and compliance perspective.

• Assist with operational responsibilities, including contributing to SOC 2 and ISO certification processes.

• Identify process improvements across Finance and Operations and implement practical solutions.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

• Proven experience consolidating multiple entities into one set of accounts.

• Strong experience leading month-end close processes and managing bookkeeping.

• Experience in fast-paced or high-growth environments.

• Strong attention to detail with a high level of reliability and diligence.

• Ability to work autonomously and balance multiple priorities effectively.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience maintaining and updating financial forecasts and cash flow models.

• Experience with cap table management software and compliance processes.

• Exposure to supporting audit, certification, or regulatory processes (e.g., SOC 2, ISO).

Personality:

• Hands-on and proactive, with a willingness to take ownership.

• Comfortable operating both at a detailed level and in strategic discussions.

• Flexible working style with strong organizational skills.

• Collaborative and adaptable in a scaling business environment.

Software & Tools:

• Accounting and bookkeeping software.

• Financial forecasting and cash flow modeling tools.

• Cap table management software.

• Compliance and certification tracking tools (SOC 2, ISO).

English Level:

C2

Schedule:

Part-Time UK Business Hours

Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the finance function within a high-growth company.

• Supportive and collaborative working environment.

title: SAP Cloud Architect - SAP Basis
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Are you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.


About the Role


As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.


Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required.


What You’ll Gain


Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.

Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.

Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.

A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Clinical Research Associate (Oncology) – São Paulo (0.4 FTE, Rescue Study)


We are seeking an experienced Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to support a Phase 2 oncology rescue study in solid tumors. The role is part‑time (0.4 FTE) and based in São Paulo, with on‑site visits to the study site every 6–8 weeks.


Key Details

  • Therapeutic area: Oncology – solid tumor
  • Phase: 2
  • 1 year contract
  • Start date: ASAP


Responsibilities

  • Perform regular on‑site monitoring visits approximately every 6–8 weeks
  • Ensure protocol compliance, data quality, and patient safety in a rescue study setting
  • Complete source data verification and support data clean‑up and query resolution
  • Review and maintain essential documents and site files
  • Collaborate closely with site staff and the project team to address study issues and implement corrective actions as needed


Requirements

  • 4–5 years of experience as a CRA
  • Proven experience monitoring oncology clinical trials, ideally in solid tumors
  • Prior experience with Phase 2 studies preferred
  • Strong knowledge of ICH‑GCP and clinical research regulations
  • Based in São Paulo (or able to reliably travel to sites in São Paulo)
  • Able to start on short notice (ASAP)


If you meet the above criteria and are interested in supporting this Phase 2 oncology rescue study, please submit your CV and availability.

  • Implementar e escalar o método Kanban em diferentes áreas da empresa, respeitando o contexto e maturidade de cada equipe;

title: Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Machine Learning
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Machine Learning

Location: Brazil (remote)

Contract: PJ (long-term)

We’re looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to join our Inbound team and build highly scalable machine learning solutions that power item attribute detection (e.g., color, material, style) and merchandise authenticity verification.

If you’re passionate about solving real-world business problems using state-of-the-art Computer Vision and ML techniques — and enjoy taking ownership from research to production — we’d love to connect.


What You’ll Do

  • Develop and deploy Computer Vision and Machine Learning solutions to solve high-impact business challenges
  • Design, build, and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable production-grade code
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract insights and drive data-informed decisions
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies (CNNs, Transformers, GANs, etc.) to build robust models
  • Lead the technical direction of key components and systems
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Tech Leads to deliver deployable solutions
  • Mentor team members and help grow domain expertise
  • Contribute to technical leadership through patents and publications


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in Computer Vision and Applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s or PhD in CS, ML, Statistics, or related field (or 8+ years of industry experience)
  • 3+ years building, deploying, and managing ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Deep understanding of ML/CV techniques: CNNs, Transformers, GANs, optimizers, regularization
  • Strong experience with experiment design, A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, and feature engineering
  • Proficiency in Python and scientific libraries (NumPy, Pandas)
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn)
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with experiment automation tools (Ray Tune, Weights & Biases, Kubeflow)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, OR, or related field
  • Experience applying ML to real-world retail problems
  • Familiarity with MLOps pipelines and tools
  • Strong ownership mindset with a focus on measurable business impact

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Pleno/Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Buscamos uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Java para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços, trabalhando de forma próxima aos times internos e aos clientes. Essa pessoa terá papel ativo no entendimento de requisitos, na construção de soluções técnicas, em integrações entre sistemas e em iniciativas de melhoria contínua, sempre com foco em qualidade, escalabilidade, observabilidade e boas práticas de engenharia de software.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Analisar e compreender necessidades de negócio e requisitos técnicos, colaborando com equipes internas e stakeholders para desenhar soluções adequadas e sustentáveis;
  • Desenvolver e manter código de alta qualidade, seguindo padrões, boas práticas e princípios de arquitetura moderna;
  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde a concepção e planejamento até implementação, testes e implantação em produção;
  • Trabalhar com arquitetura de microsserviços, integrações e APIs, garantindo comunicação eficiente entre sistemas;
  • Colaborar com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e lideranças técnicas, compartilhando conhecimento e contribuindo para a evolução do time;
  • Participar de revisões de código, cerimônias ágeis e discussões técnicas, apoiando a melhoria contínua dos processos;
  • Comunicar-se de forma clara e objetiva com o time e stakeholders, acompanhando progresso, riscos e soluções;
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências e boas práticas do mercado, aplicando esse conhecimento na evolução das soluções.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando Java, atuando na construção, evolução e sustentação de soluções em produção;

  • Experiência prática com arquitetura de microsserviços, lidando com comunicação entre serviços, versionamento, resiliência e escalabilidade;
  • Atuação com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, como Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB ou Redis, compreendendo modelagem, performance e estratégias de persistência;
  • Experiência em ambientes de cloud computing, com atuação em AWS, GCP ou Azure, apoiando deploy, escalabilidade e operação das aplicações;
  • Vivência com conteinerização e orquestração, utilizando Docker ou Kubernetes, tanto em desenvolvimento quanto em produção;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs RESTful, garantindo integração eficiente, segura e bem documentada entre sistemas;
  • Conhecimento e prática em observabilidade, utilizando ferramentas como DataDog, New Relic, Grafana ou Prometheus para monitorar, diagnosticar e evoluir aplicações em produção.

  • Conhecimento em Python, especialmente para automações, integrações, jobs ou apoio a pipelines e serviços.

Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Advogado
description:
O escritório De Bona & Piovesan Advogados procura Advogada(o) ou Bacharel(is) altamente capacitada(o)s, com perfil voltado para a área Bancária Agrícola e Urbana, com foco na defesa do Produtor Rural Endividado e na Área Bancária Urbana, também com enfoque na defesa de endividados e fraudes, interessada(o) em atuar na construção de peças processuais, petições iniciais, contestações, réplicas, recursos e pareceres jurídicos, desenvolvendo estratégias jurídicas eficazes para a defesa de produtores rurais em situações de endividamento, mantendo-se atualizada(o) sobre as legislações pertinentes e as melhores práticas do setor, e que aceite trabalhar na condição de FREELANCER e À DISTÂNCIA, respeitando as seguintes condições:


É INDISPENSÁVEL que a(o) candidata(o) seja atenta(o) aos detalhes, proativa(o), responsável, organizada(o) e ávida(o) por desafios intelectuais.


Experiência anterior e familiaridade ÍNTIMA na área são INDISPENSÁVEIS, já que haverá testes prévios que revelarão tal afinidade; sem esta, NÃO ADIANTA candidatar-se. Somará pontos em favor do FREELANCER ter vindo de família do campo ou, ao menos, possuir vivência real e conhecimento do dia a dia das pessoas do agro.


O desenvolvimento das atividades ofertadas e aceitas, se assim desejar o FREELANCER, será isento de subordinação, já que a(o) candidata(o) poderá escolher fazer ou não a tarefa encaminhada.


A onerosidade se dará exclusivamente de acordo com a produção, ou seja, haverá um valor pré-estabelecido para cada tarefa proposta. Por exemplo, a confecção de uma réplica será retribuída em R$ 120,00. Observação importante: grande parte das tarefas remetidas terá uma peça-base, a fim de que o trabalho não precise ser iniciado totalmente do zero.


O FREELANCER poderá receber um bônus por cada peça processual entregue, sendo R$ 20,00 para peças sem necessidade de ajustes; R$ 10,00 para peças com até 5 ajustes; e nenhum bônus para peças com mais de 5 ajustes.


Ajuste é QUALQUER alteração necessária apontada pelo Advogado revisor. O bônus, se houver, será pago juntamente com a peça.


Sem pessoalidade e sem habitualidade, ou seja, a(o) candidata(o) terá livre escolha para assumir a tarefa nos horários que bem entender, desde que seja atendido o prazo pré-estabelecido no momento do aceite.


Importante destacar ao FREELANCER que não é permitido entregar tarefas fora do prazo. A sanção para tal será o NÃO pagamento da peça.


Não são admitidas peças sem revisão via sistema do Word com leitura em voz alta. O FREELANCER deverá, obrigatoriamente, escutar a peça para buscar sua máxima perfeição.


Todas as peças serão novamente revisadas dentro do escritório e, ocorrendo erros inadmissíveis por duas vezes, deixar-se-á de remeter novas propostas de tarefas. Para fins de clareza, consideram-se erros inadmissíveis, por exemplo: erros de português; narração de fatos incondizentes com a situação real; citação incorreta do título de crédito pactuado ou omissão quando necessária; qualificação incorreta; endereçamento errado; notícias citadas erroneamente; dentre outras situações que comprometam minimamente a qualidade e a excelência dos préstimos do escritório aos clientes e revelem erros crassos da(o) Advogada(o).


A(o) Advogada(o) terá a oportunidade de somar conosco, interagir com a equipe e até tratar diretamente com os sócios do escritório, de forma virtual, obtendo uma visão abrangente, estratégica e integrada das atividades.

As(os) interessadas(os) deverão encaminhar, preferencialmente, currículo Lattes ou, caso não o possuam, currículo profissional, em ambas as situações para o e-mail: .
